raw.message:
Umamusume: Pretty Derby is now available for pre-download.
 Trainers can download game resources in advance to start playing faster at launch.

 Pre-download Instructions:

 1. Go to the App Store, Google Play, or Steam to install the game. Once complete, start the game.
 2. Tap or click on the Title screen.
 3. Select Pre-download.
 4. After selecting OK, the download will begin.
 *Please make sure to use a stable internet connection when downloading.
 *Please check that your device has enough storage space available before downloading.
raw.title: Pre-Download Now Available!

raw.message:
As of today, Jun 26, 2025 (UTC), the English version of Umamusume: Pretty Derby has officially launched!
 
 In Umamusume: Pretty Derby, your goal is to help Umamusume achieve their dreams. As their trainer, you will need to support them every step of the way as they strive to win races, and work together toward the ultimate goal of conquering the prestigious races of the Twinkle Series.
 We hope all our budding trainers out there are feeling ready to leap into this exciting new world!
 
 To celebrate the game's launch, we're also kicking off a release campaign featuring various in-game celebrations! Check out this notice for more details.
 
  To download the game, select one of the links below as appropriate for your device.
 
 App Store:
 https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1325457827
]  
 Google Play:
 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.cygames.umamusume
 
  We hope you'll have a great time with Umamusume: Pretty Derby!
raw.title: Official game launch! Release Celebration campaigns available!

raw.message:
In-Game Celebration of the Game's Release

 Join us in an in-game celebration of Umamusume: Pretty Derby's release!
 

 Release Celebration Login Bonus

 If you log in once during the campaign period, you will receive 1,500 carats!
 
 Availability Period: 12:30 a.m., Jun 26 - 2:59 p.m., Oct 1, 2025 (UTC)
 

 

 Head Start Login Bonus

 For the first ten days after starting the game, trainers will receive 150 carats each time they log in, up to a total 1,500 carats over the duration!
 
 Availability Period: Jun 26, 2025 (UTC) onwards
 

 

 Release Celebration Missions Part 1

 Clearing the designated in-game missions can earn you various in-game items!
 The rewards even include a 3★ Guaranteed Make Debut Ticket that allows you to scout a 3★ Umamusume!
 
Availability Period: Jun 26, 2025 (UTC) onwards
 

 

 2x Career Rewards and Daily Free Scout

 Rewards gained from Career mode will be doubled for a limited time, use this opportunity to help your Umamusume become even stronger!
 
 Availability Period: Jun 26, 2025 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 29, 2026 (UTC)
 
 We are also launching a Daily Free Scout campaign, during which you can scout for free once per day using Pretty Derby Scout or Support Card Scout, depending on the availability period!
 
 Pretty Derby Scout
 Availability Period: Jun 26 - 2:59 p.m., Jul 2, 2025 (UTC)
 
 Support Card Scout
 Availability Period: 10:00 p.m., Jul 2 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 9, 2025 (UTC)


 

 A Special Thank You from the Developers!

 A special login bonus will be available each week as thanks from the developers!
Log in within each availability period to receive a gift of 300 carats!
If you collect the gifts for all six weeks, you'll receive 1,800 carats in total!
 
 Availability Period: Jun 26 - 2:59 p.m., Jul 23, 2025 (UTC)
 
 Each Period:
 ① Jun 26 - 2:59 p.m., Jul 2, 2025 (UTC)
 ② 3:00 p.m., Jun 28 - 2:59 p.m., Jul 5, 2025 (UTC)
 ③ 3:00 p.m., Jul 2 - 2:59 p.m., Jul 9, 2025 (UTC)
 ④ 3:00 p.m., Jul 6 - 2:59 p.m., Jul 13, 2025 (UTC)
 ⑤ 3:00 p.m., Jul 14 - 2:59 p.m., Jul 21, 2025 (UTC)
 ⑥ 3:00 p.m., Jul 16 - 2:59 p.m., Jul 23, 2025 (UTC)



 

 3★ Guaranteed Head Start Scout and SSR Guaranteed Head Start Scout now available!

 A 3★ Guaranteed Head Start Scout is now available! This Trainee Umamusume 10-Scout guarantees the appearance of at least one 3★ Umamusume!
 An SSR Guaranteed Head Start Scout is also available! This Support Card 10-Scout guarantees the appearance of at least one SSR Support Card!
 Both can be purchased once each with paid carats.
 
 Availability Period: Jun 26, 2025 (UTC) onwards
 

 
 

 Preregistration Campaign Giveaway!

 As part of Umamusume: Pretty Derby's preregistration campaign, all trainers will receive the debut celebration presents below!
 • Carats × 3,750 (25 Scouts)
 • Support Points × 50,000
 • Monies × 100,000
 • Alarm Clocks × 45
 • Toughness 30 × 45
 • Goddess Statue × 30

 
 

 Special Preregistration Gift Added!

 As a special preregistration gift, trainers will receive a Head Start 3★ Voucher that allows them to choose one 3★ Umamusume to obtain!
 Note: 3★ Umamusume that can be obtained with the Head Start 3★ Voucher are limited to the 3★ Umamusume available at the time of release on Jun 26, 2025 (UTC).
 

 

 "Sakura Bakushin O's BAKUSHIN ADVICE!" Coming Soon!

 Sakura Bakushin O offers helpful knowledge on how to play the game in an easy-to-understand format with her short video series, "Sakura Bakushin O's BAKUSHIN ADVICE!" All 8 episodes are planned for a simultaneous release on the official YouTube channel after the game's launch.
 Other Umamusume will also be appearing on "Sakura Bakushin O's BAKUSHIN ADVICE!", so be sure to check it out! ♪

 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLbRq7_wpPI8lplzYnXcq2WIuUMA3-iLwH
 
 
 
[Umamusume: Pretty Derby Official Site]

raw.title: Release Celebration Campaign! Log In for Tons of Presents!

raw.message:
To celebrate the game's launch on Jun 26 (UTC), we're kicking off Part 1 of our release celebration!
 
 For all the details about the included campaigns, see below.

 As of Jun 26 (UTC), a Release Celebration Login Bonus is available!
 
 Players who log in within the availability period will receive a gift of 1,500 carats!
 
 

 Availability Period

 
  Jun 26 - 2:59 p.m., Oct 1, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Important Information

 
  The details of this campaign are subject to change without notice.
 
 As of Jun 26 (UTC), a Head Start Login Bonus is available!
 
 Each day you log in during the campaign period, you'll receive a gift of 150 carats, up to a total maximum of 1,500!
 

 Availability Period

 
  Jun 26, 2025 (UTC) onwards
 

 Important Information

 
1. The maximum number of rewards that can be claimed from this login campaign is 10.
 Note: Even if you do not log in on consecutive days, you can still claim rewards for those days you did log in.
 2. If you do not log in during the campaign period, you will not receive the rewards.
 3. The availability period and details of this campaign are subject to change without notice.
 

 As of Jun 26 (UTC), special missions are available for a limited time!
 
 Beginning on Jun 26 (UTC) and updating daily for seven days, special missions will appear under Missions on the Home screen!
 
 Complete these missions to receive great rewards, including a 3★ Guaranteed Make Debut Ticket and Star Pieces for [Peak Joy] Tokai Teio!
 

 Availability Period

 
  Jun 26, 2025 (UTC) onwards
 

 Important Information

 
1. New missions will be added at 3:00 p.m. (UTC).
 2. Release Celebration Missions will be added for seven days in total.
 3. The availability period and details of this campaign are subject to change without notice.
 

 As of Jun 26 (UTC), a 2x Career Mode Rewards campaign is available!
 
 During the campaign period, race rewards and completion rewards obtained from Career playthroughs will be doubled! Take this opportunity to complete careers with all your favorite trainees!
 
 

 Availability Period

 
  Jun 26, 2025 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 29, 2026 (UTC)
 

 Important Information

 
 1. Certain types of reward, including Bond Points and fans, are not eligible to be doubled.
 2. If the campaign period ends during a race or Career playthrough, the relevant rewards will not be doubled.
 3. For more details on Career mode, select Menu → Help from the Home screen and refer to the Career section.
 4. The availability period and details of this campaign are subject to change without notice.
 

 As of Jun 26 (UTC), the following Support Cards and Star Pieces are available in the Friend Point Exchange under Shops for a limited time!
 
 We hope you'll take this opportunity to earn Friend Points in Team Trials and exchange them for great rewards!
 
 For more details on the available items and their Friend Point costs, please refer to the in-game shop.

Newly Added Shop Items


 • [Rosy Dreams] Rice Shower Star Pieces
• [Urara's Day Off!] Haru Urara

Availability Period


 • [Rosy Dreams] Rice Shower Star Pieces:
Jun 26 (UTC) - 2:59 p.m., Aug 1, 2025 (UTC)

• [Urara's Day Off!] Haru Urara:
Jun 26, 2025 (UTC) onwards
 

 Important Information

 
 1. The availability period and details of this celebration are subject to change without notice.
 2. Items included in this celebration may become available in shops again in the future.
 

 As of Jun 26 (UTC), a Daily Free Scout campaign is available!
 
 Each day you log in during this celebration, you will be able to perform a single scout on one of the currently available scout banners, up to a maximum of 15 times.
 
 We hope you'll take this opportunity to add new Trainee and Support Cards to your roster!
 

 Eligible Scout Banners

 
 • Pretty Derby Scout
 • Support Card Scout
 
 

 Availability Period

 
 Pretty Derby Scout:
 Jun 26 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 2, 2025 (UTC) (7 days total)
 
 Support Card Scout:
 10:00 p.m., Jul 2 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 9, 2025 (UTC) (8 days total)
 

 Important Information

 
 1. Each free single scout becomes available at 3:00 p.m. (UTC). If you have not used the previous day's free scout at this time, it will be lost and cannot be carried over.
 2. If you have any free scouts remaining when this campaign ends, they will be lost. It is not possible to carry over free scouts to future scout banners.
 3. There is no difference in scout rates between free scouts from this celebration and scouts performed on the same scout banner using carats.
 4. To check the specific rates at which Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards appear from each scout banner, tap Details on the Scout screen and select the Rates tab.
 5. Please be aware that if you scout from a scout banner at the same time that it is updated, an error may occur.
 6. The availability period and details of this celebration are subject to change without notice.
 
 We're planning to kick off Release Celebration Part 2 on Jul 4 (UTC), so please look forward to that too!

Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin!!!
 Are you a new Umamusume trainer? Are you looking to improve your skills? Then "Sakura Bakushin O's BAKUSHIN ADVICE!" might be just the video series you need!
 

 Overview

 To celebrate the release of Umamusume: Pretty Derby, we've prepared a series of videos to help budding trainers get to grips with how to play the game!
 
 In these videos, Sakura Bakushin O and the other Umamusume will answer all of your pressing questions, explaining in easy-to-understand terms how to go about guiding your trainee!
 
 

 Video Contents

 This video series is made up of 8 episodes in total.
 
 [[[Episode 1: Support Cards]]]
 [[[Episode 2: Choosing Support Cards]]]
 [[[Episode 3: I Don't Want to Fail Training!]]]
 [[[Episode 4: Mood is Key!]]
 [[[Episode 5: Choosing a Race]]]
 [[[Episode 6: Running Style]]]
 [[[Episode 7: Last Spurt and Skills]]]
 [[[Episode 8: Inspiration]]]
 
 

 How to View the Videos

  Check out the videos here!
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLbRq7_wpPI8lplzYnXcq2WIuUMA3-iLwH
 
 We hope you'll take the opportunity to enjoy these special videos and get to grips with training your Umamusume!
 
 All together now, trainers... Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin!!!

raw.message:
As of 12:30 a.m., Jun 26 (UTC), the story event "Dashing towards Your Dreams" has begun!
 
 

 Event Availability Period

 12:30 a.m., Jun 26 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 9, 2025 (UTC)
 
 

 Reward Collection Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 9 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 12, 2025 (UTC)
 
 

 Event Overview

 In this story event, you can complete careers to collect Event Points, which will earn you a variety of rewards, including copies of an event-exclusive SSR Support Card. As you progress through the event, you will also unlock episodes to an exclusive story to enjoy.
 

 By collecting Event Points you can watch an event-exclusive story!
 The second half of the story will be made available later during the event.
 

 By collecting Event Points and clearing event missions, you can obtain the following rewards:
 • Event-exclusive SSR Support Card: [The Setting Sun and Rising Stars] Special Week
 • Event-exclusive Title: Dashing towards Your Dreams
 

 You can play the Prize Derby using the Prize Coins you get by playing the event!
 Among the Prize Derby bingo rewards, you have the chance to obtain the event-exclusive SSR Support Card [The Setting Sun and Rising Stars] Special Week.
 
 

 Important Information

 1. For more information on story events, please tap the Help icon on the top-right of the event's Home screen.
 2. Event Points earned in this event cannot be carried over to future events.
 3. Prize Coins earned in this event will be discarded after the reward collection period has ended.
 4. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.
 5. Additional Event Bonus Umamusume and Event Bonus Support Cards may become available during the event.

Thank you for playing Umamusume: Pretty Derby.

 We hope you're enjoying your time with the trainees!
 We'd like to offer a helping hand to get you to the peak of the URA Finale!

 

 Training Booster Giveaway

 In appreciation of your support, we've sent an SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Ticket to all trainers!
 
 

 Gift Contents

 SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Ticket × 1
 
 

 Eligible Trainers

 All trainers who start the game before 11:59 p.m., Jul 3, 2026 (UTC).
 
 

 How to Receive

 After completing the game's tutorial, select Presents on the Home screen to find your gift waiting.
 Note: If you don't see the gift in your Presents, try returning to the title screen and loading the game again. 
 
 

 How to Use the SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Ticket

 The SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Ticket can be used to scout from the SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Scout, available under Scout in the footer menu.
 
 

 Gift Expiry

 This gift will expire if not claimed within 30 days after it is sent to your Presents.
 Note: Please be aware that expired gifts will automatically be deleted, so be sure to claim them before this happens.
 
 

 Important Information

 1. The details of SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Scout are subject to change without notice.
 2. The rates at which Support Cards appear from the SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Scout differ for each Support Card.
 3. Please be aware that it is possible to obtain duplicate Support Cards from the SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Scout.
 4. Depending on factors such as the stability of your connection to the server, it is possible that scout animations may be skipped or displayed incorrectly. Such issues do not affect the Support Cards you actually receive.
 5. The outcome of each scout is calculated individually using a randomized algorithm. As such, there is no guarantee that a Support Card with a 1% rate will appear within 100 scouts.

 (If you encounter this issue, it should be possible to progress the Career by restarting the game and selecting "See All Race Results" instead.)
 • In the story event "Make a Splash! Summer Showdown! ☆," an incorrect summary is displayed below the image introducing the event. The correct text is as follows:

 Correct text: The midsummer Splash Recreation event is underway! Mejiro McQueen finds herself roped into the competition by Gold Ship, and with both unwilling to back down, the two face off! Meanwhile, competition is sparking off between Sakura Chiyono O and Maruzensky. Who will win the action-packed water pistol battle?

 [Update: 6:00 p.m., Jul 1, 2026 (UTC)]
 • Certain Career Events for Yaeno Muteki are displayed in Japanese.

 • In the Career Scenario "Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit!", unintended teams may appear in Team Races.

 (This issue does not affect Career progress.)

 [Update: 6:06 p.m., Jun 27 (UTC)]
 • In the event "Aim for the Stars! Dream Team", the number of Scout Race Tickets is not being updated even after the scheduled time has passed.

 [Update: 8:20 a.m., Apr 20 (UTC)]
 • In the Career Scenario "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax," using training items on attributes greater than 1,000 may cause digits to be cut off, resulting in an incorrect value being displayed.

 (Please note that this issue only affects the displayed value; the actual attribute value is calculated correctly.)

 [Update: 11:30 a.m., Apr 1 (UTC)]
 • Part of the mission text for Part 3 of the Special Missions "Tracen Special: Training the Trainer" contains an error.

 Incorrect: Complete a Career playthrough with at least 3 attributes at S rank or better
 Correct: Complete a Career playthrough with at least 2 attributes at S rank or better
 (Please note that this issue is only present in the mission text; completing a Career playthrough with any 2 attributes at S rank or better will result in clearing the mission.)

 [Update: 8:30 a.m., Mar 26 (UTC)]
 • In the Career Scenario "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax," when purchasing certain items from the Pro Shop with the automatic use option enabled, the "Used" badge is displayed in Japanese.

 (For more information on automatic use of training items, please refer to Trackblazer: Start of the Climax under Career in Help.)

 [Update: 8:00 a.m., Feb 18 (UTC)]
 • In the Steam version, if the Agenda is open in the right-hand menu when starting a Recreation minigame, certain icons in the Scheduled Races screen display incorrectly.

 (Please note that this issue only affects the display; Career gameplay outcomes are not affected. If you encounter this issue, you can return the display to normal by re-opening the Agenda after navigating to a different tab.)

 [Update: 11:09 a.m., Jan 30 (UTC)]
 • In the story event "Blossoming Beginnings! New Year's Karuta Showdown," the Event Bonus effect of applicable Support Cards is not displayed correctly, even if they are in the Trainer's possession.

   (Please note that this issue only affects the display; when completing a Career, the Event Bonus effect is correctly applied to the Event Points received.)
 
 [Update: 9:00 a.m., Jan 22 (UTC)]
 • The text regarding the requirements for obtaining the "Super Sprinter" epithet is currently incorrect.

 Incorrect: Win at least 7 graded races of 1,400 meters or less and attain Stamina and Power of 1,200 or higher
 Correct: Win at least 7 graded races of 1,400 meters or less and attain Speed and Power of 1,200 or higher
 *This is only a display issue―the actual requirements for the epithet are correct.

 [Update: 9:00 a.m., Jan 22 (UTC)]
 • In the Steam version's Options menu, the options listed under Main Settings → Screen Orientation →　Graphics Settings do not change the graphics quality as indicated.

 (Currently, selecting the "Standard" and "Basic" options listed in this location instead switches between Windowed and Borderless Fullscreen display modes. To adjust graphics quality, please use the "Standard" and "Basic" options listed under Graphics → Quality on the same page.)

 [Update: 7:00 a.m., Jan 6 (UTC)]
 • An incorrect Umamusume icon displays in Room Matches and the Trophy Room.

 [Update: 6:45 a.m., Dec 26 (UTC)]
 • The parameters that can be gained from an event choice may actually be higher than what's displayed in the pop-up when checking its effects.

 [Update: 8:00 a.m., Dec 17 (UTC)]
 • The Members screen cannot be scrolled when accessed from Invite under the Club menu.

 [Update: 9:00 a.m., Dec 2 (UTC)]
 • In some cases, the Current Promotion Line in Team Trials will display "0 pts".

 (Please note that this issue only affects the number displayed; your actual score is unaffected.)

 [Update: 5:30 a.m., Nov 27 (UTC)]
 • The skill level for Agnes Digital's Unique Skill, "OMG! (ﾟ∀ﾟ) The Final Sprint! ☆", may sometimes not increase during the "Fan Fest" trainee event despite fulfilling the prerequisites.

 [Update: 9:30 a.m., Oct 3 (UTC)]
 • The number of completed missions is not properly displayed on the Missions icon on the Home screen even when there are mission rewards available to collect.

 (Please note that this issue only affects the number displayed on the Missions icon; mission rewards can still be collected by selecting the icon as usual. If you encounter this issue, restarting the game should cause the correct number to appear on the icon.)

 [Update: 10:30 a.m., Oct 2 (UTC)]
 • Some errors were included in the Help text for the "Uma Quest: Epic Odyssey" story event.

 (The text has been fixed and any incorrect information has been removed.)

 [Update: 7:20 a.m., Oct 1 (UTC)]
 • On Android devices, an error is displayed repeatedly when starting a new game, after entering the user's country/region and birth date. It is possible to bypass this error and progress the game by selecting the Retry option twice.

 [Update: 10:30 a.m., Aug 21 (UTC)]
 • In the 10:00 p.m., Aug 20 (UTC) notice announcing new Spotlight Pretty Derby and Spotlight Support Card Scouts, the rarity of the SR Support Card "[The World's My Oyster] Seeking the Pearl" was incorrectly listed as SSR.

 (This issue was only present in the notice text; scout rates etc. were not affected.)

 [Update: 10:30 a.m., Aug 5 (UTC)]
 • When playing Team Trials on the Steam version of the game, trainers may be unable to proceed past the results screen.

 [Update: 12:40 p.m., Aug 1 (UTC)]
 • When attempting to purchase carats, an error listed with Error Code 102 can occur.

 [Update: 6:00 a.m., Jul 11 (UTC)]
 • The Main Mission "Link App Data" currently cannot be completed in the Steam version.

 • When using certain Android devices (Android 16), the app may not launch properly.

   These issues will be corrected in future updates.
 It may take some time before fixes can be implemented, so we ask for your patience.

 We sincerely apologize to any trainers who are inconvenienced by these issues.

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
 The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Taurus Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Taurus Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve one or no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least three wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 • If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 • Once your team has been registered for entry, it cannot be changed.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your placement, and winners will receive the following event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Taurus Cup Platinum
 • Taurus Cup Gold
 • Taurus Cup Silver
 • Taurus Cup Bronze

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Taurus Cup Entry Tickets!
 In this Champions Meeting, you will be able to obtain many Taurus Cup Entry Tickets, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. If the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other trainers in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 5. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meeting events.
 6. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

At 10:00 p.m., Sep 11 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Gemini Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Gemini Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
 In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

   

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 11 - 9:59 p.m., Sep 17, 2025 (UTC)
 

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 7 - 9:59 p.m., Sep 15, 2025 (UTC)
 Please note:
 • After 10:00 p.m., Sep 11 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Sep 13(UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 10:00 p.m., Sep 15 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Sep 11 - 9:59 p.m., Sep 13, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Sep 13 - 9:59 p.m., Sep 15, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 15 - 9:59 a.m., Sep 16, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Sep 16 - 9:59 p.m., Sep 16, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 16 - 9:59 p.m., Sep 17, 2025 (UTC)

   

 Race Conditions

 Kyoto / Turf / 3200 m / Right-Handed / Outer / Spring / Sunny / Firm

   

 Changes from the Taurus Cup

 Change 1

 The requirements to advance from Round 2 to the final round have been adjusted.
 There is no change to the requirements to advance from Round 1. These changes apply equally to the Open and Graded Leagues.

 ■ Before Change
 ▼ Round 2 (Group A)
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve one or no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 ▼ Round 2 (Group B)
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 ■After Change
 ▼ Round 2 (Group A)
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 ▼ Round 2 (Group B)
 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Change 2

 The results required to earn event-exclusive titles have been adjusted.
 For more details, check Rewards on the main Champions Meeting screen.

 In accordance with these adjustments, the conditions to earn the following titles have also been adjusted:

 • Taurus Cup Platinum
 • Taurus Cup Gold
 • Taurus Cup Silver
 • Taurus Cup Bronze
 These adjustments will apply when earning the titles in future events. Past results are not affected.

   

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.
 

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B+ cannot participate in the Open League.)
 

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

   

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
 The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

   

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Gemini Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

   

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Gemini Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.
 

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

   

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.
 

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 Once your team has been registered for entry, it cannot be changed.

   

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Gemini Cup Platinum
 • Gemini Cup Gold
 • Gemini Cup Silver
 • Gemini Cup Bronze

   

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Gemini Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

   

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents.
 However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the Menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meeting events.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Oct 2 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.
   

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 2 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 10, 2025 (UTC)
   

 Outline

By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
Transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC). 
 

 Request Conditions

The desired conditions for each trainer's request are set according to Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements. 
 You may only select Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions for transfer.

 Rank

 A different rank exists for each request.
 The higher the rank, the greater the rewards you can receive.  

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.  

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces your amount by one transfer.
 Once your remaining transfers reaches 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.
   

 Rewards

 Your rewards will differ depending on the transfer destination.

 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume Star Piece, you will earn the Star Piece of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
   

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to the notice that will be posted when the event begins, or Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

At 10:00 p.m., Oct 10 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Cancer Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Cancer Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
 In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 10 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 16, 2025 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 7 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 15, 2025 (UTC)
Please note:
 • After 10:00 p.m., Oct 10 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Oct 12 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 10:00 p.m., Oct 15 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Oct 10 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 12, 2025 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Oct 12 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 14, 2025 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 14 - 9:59 a.m., Oct 15, 2025 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Oct 15 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 15, 2025 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 15 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 16, 2025 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Tokyo / Turf / 1600 m / Left-Handed / Summer / Sunny / Good

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B+ cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
 The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Cancer Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Cancer Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 Once your team has been registered for entry, it cannot be changed.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Cancer Cup Platinum
 • Cancer Cup Gold
 • Cancer Cup Silver
 • Cancer Cup Bronze

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Cancer Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents.
 However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the Menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Oct 7 (UTC), a new Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout have begun!
 The Spotlight Pretty Derby Scount features a new Trainee Umamusume.
 The Spotlight Support Card Scout features a selection of Support Cards showcasing characters who have won the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.
 The newly debuting [Tracen Academy] Narita Brian will also be featured.

 During the Spotlight period, scout rates for Spotlight Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards are increased!
 In addition, during the Spotlight period, if you obtain a Spotlight Trainee Umamusume, you will receive more of her Star Pieces than usual as a bonus.
 During the availability period, you can earn bonuses as many times as you acquire the Spotlight Trainee Umamusume, including when you do so by using Trainee Exchange Points.

 The Spotlight Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards are listed below.
   

 Spotlight Scout Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 7 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 16, 2025 (UTC)
   

 Trainee Umamusume

 ■ Debut Trainee Umamusume (Spotlight)
 ★★★ [Authentic / 1928] Gold City

 ■ Spotlight Trainee Umamusume
 ★★★ [Authentic / 1928] Gold City
 Scout Bonus:
 [Authentic / 1928] Gold City Star Piece × 90
   

 Support Cards

 ■ Spotlight Support Cards
 • SSR [Even the Littlest Bud] Nishino Flower
 • SSR [Wild Rider] Vodka
 • R [Tracen Academy] Narita Brian
   

 Important Information

 1. To check the specific rates at which Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards appear from the Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout, tap Details on the Scout screen and select the Rates tab.
 2. Support Cards will not appear in the Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout.
 3. Trainee Umamusume will not appear in the Spotlight Support Card Scout.
 4. Trainee Exchange Points and Support Card Exchange Points from this Spotlight Scout cannot be carried over to future Spotlight Scouts.
 5. Trainee Exchange Points and Support Card Exchange Points not utilized during the Spotlight Scout availability period will automatically be converted into Clovers.
 6. The Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout schedules and contents are subject to change without notice.
 7. What you can exchange Trainee Exchange Points and Support Card Exchange Points for differs depending on the Spotlight Scout.
 8. Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards that you can exchange Exchange Points for may become available again in the future.
 9. Trainee Umamusume with the same name cannot be on the same team, nor can they be selected as Legacy Umamusume at the same time in Career mode.
   

 Umamusume Story Sneak Peek

 To celebrate the new arrival of [Authentic / 1928] Gold City, Episodes 1 through 4 of her Umamusume Story will be fully unlocked for a limited time!
 During the sneak peek period, you can watch the story episodes even without fulfilling their unlock conditions!
   

 Umamusume Story Sneak Peek Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 7 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 16, 2025 (UTC)  

 Important Information

 1. During the sneak peek period, even if you have not obtained [Authentic / 1928] Gold City, you can still watch Episodes 1 through 4 of her Umamusume Story!
 2. If you do watch Episodes 1 through 4 of Gold City's Umamusume Story during the sneak peek period, you will obtain first-watch carat rewards, Umamusume Story rewards, and Umamusume Archive experience.
 3. If you do not watch Episodes 1 through 4 of Gold City's Umamusume Story during the sneak peek period, you will not obtain first-watch carat rewards, Umamusume Story rewards, or Umamusume Archive experience.
 4. After the sneak peek period has ended, any unwatched Umamusume Stories will once again become locked.
 5. Umamusume Stories can be viewed after the tutorial is completed.
raw.title: Spotlight Pretty Derby and Spotlight Support Card Scouts out now!

raw.message:
Thank you for playing Umamusume: Pretty Derby.

 We hope you're enjoying your time with the trainees!
 We'd like to offer a helping hand to get you to the peak of the URA Finale!

 

 Training Booster Giveaway

 In appreciation of your support, we've sent an SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Ticket to all trainers!
 
 

 Gift Contents

 SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Ticket × 1
 
 

 Eligible Trainers

 All trainers who start the game before 11:59 p.m., Oct 7, 2026 (UTC).
 
 

 How to Receive

 After completing the game's tutorial, select Presents on the Home screen to find your gift waiting.
 Note: If you don't see the gift in your Presents, try returning to the title screen and loading the game again. 
 
 

 How to Use the SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Ticket

 The SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Ticket can be used to scout from the SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Scout, available under Scout in the footer menu.
 
 

 Gift Expiry

 This gift will expire if not claimed within 30 days after it is sent to your Presents.
 Note: Please be aware that expired gifts will automatically be deleted, so be sure to claim them before this happens.
 
 

 Important Information

 1. The details of SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Scout are subject to change without notice.
 2. The rates at which Support Cards appear from the SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Scout differ for each Support Card.
 3. Please be aware that it is possible to obtain duplicate Support Cards from the SSR Guaranteed Make Debut Scout.
 4. Depending on factors such as the stability of your connection to the server, it is possible that scout animations may be skipped or displayed incorrectly. Such issues do not affect the Support Cards you actually receive.
 5. The outcome of each scout is calculated individually using a randomized algorithm. As such, there is no guarantee that a Support Card with a 1% rate will appear within 100 scouts.

raw.title: The story event "Beaches, Bathing Suits & Blazing Trails" is coming soon!

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Oct 14 (UTC), the story event "Beaches, Bathing Suits & Blazing Trails" has begun!
   

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 14 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 27, 2025 (UTC)
   

 Reward Collection Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 27 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 30, 2025 (UTC)
   

 Event Overview

 In this story event, you can complete careers to collect Event Points, which will earn you a variety of rewards, including copies of an event-exclusive SSR Support Card. As you progress through the event, you will also unlock episodes to an exclusive story to enjoy.

 By collecting Event Points you can watch an event-exclusive story!

 By collecting Event Points and clearing event missions, you can obtain the following rewards!
 • Event-Exclusive SSR Support Card: [Mini☆Vacation] Daiwa Scarlet
 • Event-Exclusive Title: Beaches, Bathing Suits & Blazing Trails

 You can play the Prize Derby using the Prize Coins you get by playing the event!
 Among the Prize Derby bingo rewards, you have the chance to obtain the event-exclusive SSR Support Card [Mini☆Vacation] Daiwa Scarlet.
 If you perform 25 spins on a single bingo sheet, that sheet's spin quota is fulfilled, and any subsequent spins are guaranteed to land on segments you have not yet filled in.
   

 Changes from the Previous Story Event

 1. Preview voices have been added.
 Preview voices can be played after the event reward collection period has ended by selecting Extra under Story on the Home screen.
 2. The conditions for unlocking the voices that can be heard on the event screen and event mission page have changed.
 They will automatically unlock as you view the event-exclusive story, and can be played from Trainer Notes in the Umamusume Archive the next time you log in.
 3. Event missions and mission rewards have been adjusted.
   

 Important Information

 1. For more information on story events, please tap the Help icon on the top-right of the event screen.
 2. Event Points earned in this event cannot be carried over to future events.
 3. Prize Coins earned in this event will be converted into monies after the reward collection period has ended.
 4. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.
 5. Additional Event Bonus Umamusume and Event Bonus Support Cards may become available during the event.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Oct 21 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.
   

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 21 - 9:59 p.m., Oct 25, 2025 (UTC)
   

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 

 Request Conditions

 The desired conditions for each trainer's request are set according to Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only select Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions for transfer.
 

 Rank

 A different rank exists for each request.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.
 

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.
 

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces your amount by one transfer.
 Once your remaining transfers reaches 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.
   

 Rewards

 Your rewards will differ depending on the transfer destination.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume Star Piece, you will earn the Star Piece of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
   

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to the notice that will be posted when the event begins, or Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

raw.message:
At 10:00 p.m., Nov 3 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Leo Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Leo Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meetings is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 3 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 9, 2025 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 30 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 7, 2025 (UTC)
 Please note:
 • After 10:00 p.m., Nov 3 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Nov 5 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 10:00 p.m., Nov 7 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Nov 3 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 5, 2025 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Nov 5 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 7, 2025 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 7 - 9:59 a.m., Nov 8, 2025 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Nov 8 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 8, 2025 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 8 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 9, 2025 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Hanshin / Turf / 2200 m / Right-Handed / Inner / Summer / Sunny / Firm

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran umamusume with a Career Rank of B+ cannot participate in the Open League.)

League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 x 3
 • Alarm Clock x 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Rounds 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Leo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Leo Cup Entry Ticket of 30 carats.)
 •You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will be automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 Once your team has been registered for entry, it cannot be changed.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Leo Cup Platinum
 • Leo Cup Gold
 • Leo Cup Silver
 • Leo Cup Bronze

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Leo Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the Menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

 10:00 p.m., Nov 3 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 9, 2025 (UTC)
 

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 30 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 7, 2025 (UTC)
 Please note:
 • After 10:00 p.m., Nov 3 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Nov 5 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 10:00 p.m., Nov 7 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Nov 3 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 5, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Nov 5 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 7, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 7 - 9:59 a.m., Nov 8, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Nov 8 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 8, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 8 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 9, 2025 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Hanshin / Turf / 2200 m / Right-handed / Inner / Summer / Sunny / Firm

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.
 

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B+ cannot participate in the Open League.)
 

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
 The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Leo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Leo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.
 

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.
 

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 Once your team has been registered for entry, it cannot be changed.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will recieve a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Leo Cup Platinum
 • Leo Cup Gold
 • Leo Cup Silver
 • Leo Cup Bronze

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Leo Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the Menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Nov 6 (UTC), the new Career scenario "Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit!" has been added to the game!
 In this new scenario, you can raise your trainees while enjoying a different story and different gameplay systems from the existing "The Beginning! URA Finale!" scenario.
 To get started with the new scenario, simply select Career from the Home screen, then select "Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit!"

 "Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit!" Story Outline

 A new Umamusume drama is unfolding!
 A revival of team showdowns is happening on campus!
 But... could Tracen be in danger?!

 The Unity Cup: a tournament in which Umamusume can come together and compete not as rivals, but as teammates.
 Though this contest had once faded with the times, it's been brought back by popular demand!
 However, the announcement of Director Akikawa's long-term absence and the decision for executive URA member Riko Kashimoto to fill in as director casts a dark cloud over the academy...

 Meet new characters and utilize new training systems unique to this scenario!
 Build your best team and race together toward the finish line in the Unity Cup!

 Featured Characters

 Scenario Systems

 Here's a sneak peek of the new systems you'll encounter in the "Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit!" scenario!

 Unity Cup

 The Unity Cup plays out as a series of team showdowns.
 To achieve success in this scenario, you'll need to perform well in Unity Cup matches in addition to achieving your trainee's personal goals.
 It's your job to build a team of racers and lead them to victory!

 The Unity Cup consists of five showdowns: four preseason matches followed by the finals.
 In the preseason matches, your Team Ranking will increase based on the rankings of the teams you defeat.
 Try to take on formidable foes to climb to the number one spot!

 Team Titles

 You can earn new Team Titles based on your Team Ranking and Team Power.
 If you make it to the end of a Career playthrough with a great Team Title, your trainee will reap the benefits.

 Team Power

 Team Power is a measure of the overall attributes (Speed, Stamina, Power, Guts, and Wit) of the team members you have assembled.
 It will increase as you train your team members.
 Team members can join in with your trainee's training sessions, so try to select options that benefit everyone!

 In this scenario, Training levels will increase once the attributes of all team members (including your trainee) reach certain milestones.
 It's important to keep an eye on the progress of the whole team!

 Unity Training and Spirit Bursts

 Unity Training is a phenomenon that can occur at random when initiating a training session.
 When it occurs, you'll see a big increase in the attributes of the participating team members.
 What's more, the more team members participate in Unity Training, the more that training session will benefit your trainee.

 After performing a lot of Unity Training sessions, team members can trigger a Spirit Burst.
 Spirit Bursts allow team members to greatly increase their attributes beyond their usual limits.
 Your trainee will also see increased attribute gains, and can even obtain skill hints.

 A Gift to Celebrate

 To celebrate the release of the new scenario, we've sent a gift of 1,500 carats to all trainers!
 See below for details of this giveaway.

 Gift Contents

 Carats × 1,500

 Eligible Trainers

 All trainers who start the game before 11:59 p.m., Nov 6, 2026 (UTC)

 How to Receive

 After completing the tutorial, select Presents on the Home screen to find your gift waiting.
 If you don't see the gift in your Presents, try returning to the title screen and loading the game again. 

 Gift Expiry

 Gifts will expire if not claimed within 30 days after they are sent to your Presents.
 Note: Please be aware that expired gifts will automatically be deleted, so be sure to claim them before this happens.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on the new Career scenario, please refer to "Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit!" under Career in Help.
 2. The details of Career scenarios are subject to change without notice.
 3. The details of the 1,500-carat giveaway are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
Thank you for playing Umamusume: Pretty Derby!

 Since the game's release in June, countless trainers around the world have joined us in the world of Umamusume. As thanks for all your support over the past months, we're holding a number of in-game Half Anniversary celebrations. We hope you enjoy them!

 On 10:00 p.m., Nov 6 (UTC), we released "Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit!" the first new Career Scenario since the game's launch.

 In this fresh new scenario, you can enjoy an inspiring tale of the Tracen students' youthful passion, while enjoying new Career features such as team showdowns and Unity Training, concerts featuring the new song "WINnin' 5," and more exciting race scenes than ever before.

 A Message to Our Trainers

 When developing the game Umamusume: Pretty Derby, we aimed to give our trainers the experience of teaming up with their Umamusume trainees to chase their dreams together, sharing in their triumphs and accomplishments. To achieve this, we've done our best to reflect the spectacle and drama of the real-life horses' stories, while fostering a sense of reality in the Umamusume world through love and passion for the characters.

 The success we've seen so far could never have happened without the support of all the fans who have shown their passion for Umamusume since before the game's launch, and all the trainers who have poured that passion into the game since it released. To all of you out there, thank you from the bottom of our hearts! But of course, this race is still only just beginning. We'll keep working to bring you the best content we possibly can!

 Finally, as a token of our gratitude for your support, we have gifted all our trainers with 1,500 carats at 2:00 a.m., Nov 13, 2025 (UTC).
We hope you'll continue to support the Umamusume as they race onwards into the future!

[Update: 11:25 a.m., Nov 17 (UTC)]
Some text has been updated for clarity.
We apologize for any confusion this may have caused.

—The Umamusume: Pretty Derby Development and Operation Team

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Nov 11 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 11 - 9:59 p.m., Nov 15, 2025 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC)

 Request Conditions

 The desired conditions for each trainer's request are set according to Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only select Veteran Umamusume that meet the application conditions for transfer.

 Reward Rank

 A different reward rank exists for each request.
 The higher the reward rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each application has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer apply once the availability period has passed.

 Amount of Times You Can Transfer

 The amount of possible transfers per request are limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces your amount by one transfer.
 Once your remaining transfers reaches 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

 Your rewards will differ depending on the transfer destination.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces, you will earn Star Pieces of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

 Select Runner History to view the Umamusume you have entered in races so far, including overall results for each racer.
 (Please note that the Runner History option does not include data from previous Champions Meeting events.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Virgo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Virgo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 Once your team has been registered for entry, it cannot be changed.

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 • Virgo Cup Platinum
 • Virgo Cup Gold
 • Virgo Cup Silver
 • Virgo Cup Bronze

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Virgo Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)
