 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.

 Reward Collection Period

 10:00 p.m., Nov 24 - 9:59 p.m., Dec 9, 2025 (UTC)

 Event Overview

 In this story event, you can complete careers to collect Event Points, which will earn you a variety of rewards, including copies of an event-exclusive SSR Support Card. As you progress through the event, you will also unlock episodes to an exclusive story to enjoy.

 By collecting Event Points you can watch an event-exclusive story!

 By collecting Event Points and clearing event missions, you can obtain the following rewards!
 • Event-exclusive SSR Support Card: [The Ghost Finds Halloween Magic] Mihono Bourbon
 • Event-exclusive Title: Halloween Makeover!

 You can play the Prize Derby using the Prize Coins you get by playing the event!
 Among the Prize Derby bingo rewards, you have the chance to obtain the event-exclusive SSR Support Card [The Ghost Finds Halloween Magic] Mihono Bourbon.
 If you perform 25 spins on a single bingo sheet, that sheet's spin quota is fulfilled, and any subsequent spins are guaranteed to land on segments you have not yet filled in.

Changes from the Previous Story Event

1. The Event Boost function has been added.
Using Event Boost doubles the amount of TP your Umamusume consumes during training, but when training has finished, the Event Points and Prize Coins you receive will be also be twofold.
Note: Event Rewards that are not Event Points or Prize Coins have not changed.
2. The ability to use all your turns in one spin in the Prize Derby has been added.
This setting can be changed from the Options button in the top-right of the Prize Derby screen.
3. Event Points completion rewards have been adjusted.
Rainbow Crystal Shards have been added to Event Points completion rewards.
4. Bingo rewards have been adjusted.
Gold Crystal Shards have been added to bingo rewards.
5. Event Missions and Mission Rewards have been adjusted.
6. Unredeemed rewards from clearing event daily missions will now be sent to your Presents next time you log in.
Note: Unredeemed rewards will no longer be sent to your Presents once the event collection period ends.
Note: Rewards sent to your Presents can no longer be redeemed once the event collection period ends.
7. The conditions for unlocking voice lines that can be heard in the Prize Derby have been adjusted.
Performing a single spin of the Prize Derby will now unlock all possible voice lines for the relevant Umamusume, regardless of the result.
(Unlocked voice lines van be played from Trainer Notes in the Umamusume Archive.)
8. Changes to the effects of event bonuses are as follows.
[Before Changes]
When playing Career mode with a Trainee Umamusume or Support Card with an event bonus, an event bonus would be added onto the amount of event points earned at the end of your Career.
[After Changes]
If you possess a Trainee Umamusume or Support Card with an event bonus, an event bonus will be applied to the amount of event points earned at the end of any Career.
Among the Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards you either possess or have selected for your deck, the ones granting the highest bonuses will be automatically added per Umamusume, and their total will be your event bonus.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on story events, please tap the Help icon on the top-right of the event's home screen.
 2. Event Points earned in this event cannot be carried over to future events.
 3. Prize Coins earned in this event will be converted into monies after the reward collection period has ended.
 4. The event schedule and contents may be changed without warning.
 5. Additional Event Bonus Umamusume and Event Bonus Support Cards may become available during the event.

As of 10:00 p.m., Dec 1 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Dec 1 - 9:59 p.m., Dec 5, 2025 (UTC)

Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 The desired conditions for each trainer's request are set according to Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only select Veteran Umamusume that meet the application conditions for transfer.

 Reward Rank

 A different reward rank exists for each request.
 The higher the reward rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each application has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer apply once the availability period has passed.

 Amount of Times You Can Transfer

 The amount of possible transfers per request are limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces your amount by one transfer.
 Once your remaining transfers reaches 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

 Your rewards will differ depending on the transfer destination.
 Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume Star Piece, you will earn the Star Piece of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to the notice that will be posted when the event begins, or Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Dec 12 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Libra Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Libra Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
 In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 Champions Meetings are unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Dec 12 - 9:59 p.m., Dec 18, 2025 (UTC)
 

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Dec 8 - 9:59 p.m., Dec 16, 2025 (UTC)
 Please note:
 • After 10:00 p.m., Dec 12 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Dec 14 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Dec 16 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Dec 12 - 9:59 p.m., Dec 14, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Dec 14 - 9:59 p.m., Dec 16, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Dec 16 - 9:59 a.m., Dec 17, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Dec 17 - 9:59 p.m., Dec 17, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Dec 17 - 9:59 p.m., Dec 18, 2025 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Kyoto / Turf / 3,000m / Right-handed / Outer / Fall / Weather: Sunny / Turf: Firm

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.
 

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B+ cannot participate in the Open League.)
 

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
 The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Libra Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Libra Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.
 

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.
 

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 Once your team has been registered for entry, it cannot be changed.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Libra Cup Platinum
 • Libra Cup Gold
 • Libra Cup Silver
 • Libra Cup Bronze

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Libra Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents.
 However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. Please be aware that this event's missions reset at a different time from standard daily missions.
 9. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Dec 18 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.
 

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Dec 18 - 9:59 p.m., Dec 22, 2025 (UTC)
 

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 

 Request Conditions

 The desired conditions for each trainer's request are set according to Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only select Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions for transfer.
 

 Rank

 A different rank exists for each request.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.
 

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.
 

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces your amount by one transfer.
 Once your remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.
 

 Rewards

 Your rewards will differ depending on the transfer destination.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces, you will earn the Star Piece of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

raw.message:
At 10:00 p.m., Jan 1 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Scorpio Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Scorpio Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 Champions Meetings are unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 1 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 7, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Dec 28 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 5, 2026 (UTC)
 Please note:
 • After 10:00 p.m., Jan 1 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Jan 3 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Jan 5 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Jan 1 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 3, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Jan 3 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 5, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 5 - 9:59 a.m., Jan 6, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Jan 6 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 6, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 6 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 7, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Tokyo / Turf / 2,000m (Medium) / Left-Handed / Fall / Weather: Rain / Turf: Soft

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B+ cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Scorpio Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Scorpio Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 Once your team has been registered for entry, it cannot be changed.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Scorpio Cup Platinum
 • Scorpio Cup Gold
 • Scorpio Cup Silver
 • Scorpio Cup Bronze

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Scorpio Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. Please be aware that this event's missions reset at a different time from standard daily missions.
 9. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
At 10:00 p.m., Jan 23 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Sagittarius Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Sagittarius Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 Champions Meetings are unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 23 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 29, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 19 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 27, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Jan 23 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Jan 25 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Jan 27 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Jan 23 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 25, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Jan 25 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 27, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 27 - 9:59 a.m., Jan 28, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Jan 28 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 28, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 28 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 29, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Nakayama / Turf / 2,500m (Long) / Right-Handed / Inner / Winter / Sunny / Firm

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B+ cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Sagittarius Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Sagittarius Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 Once your team has been registered for entry, it cannot be changed.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Sagittarius Cup Platinum
 • Sagittarius Cup Gold
 • Sagittarius Cup Silver
 • Sagittarius Cup Bronze

Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Sagittarius Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately, and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. Please be aware that this event's missions reset at a different time from standard daily missions.
 9. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Jan 15 (UTC), a Trainer Aptitude Test event has begun!

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 15 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 23, 2026 (UTC)

 Reward Collection, Test Coin Exchange, and Rankings Display Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 23 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 26, 2026 (UTC)

 Event Overview

 The Trainer Aptitude Test is an event where trainers can test their prowess in eligible Career scenarios and aim to achieve a high test rating in their Career results.
 Trainers can obtain rewards by clearing event missions with the score obtained from their Career results and test rating.

 Event-Eligible Career Scenarios

 Unity Cup: Shine On, Team Spirit!

 How to Participate

 When selecting an eligible Career scenario, you can choose "Take on a Trainer Aptitude Test" to participate.

 Test Contents

 1. Sprint Test
 2. Mile Test
 3. Medium Test
 4. Long Test
 5. Dirt Test
 6. Extra
 7. Free Test
 In the beginning, only "Sprint Test" will be selectable. Achieving a test result of C or higher will unlock the next test.
 "Extra" and "Free Test" will also appear in Tests once each test has been unlocked.
 Be sure to aim for a high test score with Umamusume who suit the aptitudes of each test!


 By earning a high result in your test results and event missions, you can obtain Test Coins and other rewards!

 Test Coins

 Test Coins are an item that can be obtained by taking part in events. They can be exchanged for various items on the Test Coins Exchange screen.
 Note: Details on Test Coins can be found under "Test Coins Exchange" on the Event Shop screen, or by navigating to the Shop from the Home screen.
 Note: The period during which Test Coins can be exchanged is denoted when "Special" is displayed over the Shop icon on the Home screen.

 [Special Exchangeable Items]
 • Carats
 • Rainbow Crystal Shards
 • Gold Crystal Shards
 • Trainee Scout Ticket
 • Support Scout Ticket

 This is the top score ranking of all trainers who have passed the test. The top 100 scores are displayed.
 During the event's availability period, your Veteran Umamusume with the highest score is eligible for the ranking.
 Note: Results displayed in the ranking reset every day at 3:00 p.m. (UTC).
 Note: On the first day of the event, rankings can not be viewed due to score tallying.
 Note: Even if a Veteran Umamusume ranked in the top 100 is transferred, their results will not disappear.

 From 4:00 p.m., Jan 16, 2026 (UTC), leading Umamusume ranked in the top 30 can be borrowed without limit during the event availability period.

As of 10:00 p.m., Jan 27 (UTC), the Daily Free 10-Scout event has begun!

 Each day you log in during this campaign, you will be able to perform a 10x scout on one of the currently available scout banners, up to a maximum of 10 times.

 Each free 10x scout becomes available every day at 3:00 p.m. (UTC).
 The daily free 10x scout is available once per day. If the eligible scout banner changes after using your daily free 10x scout, then you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for it until the next time it resets.
 Additionally, trainers will be able to use the Free Scout Stock function only once during this event.

 Daily Free 10-Scout Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 27 - 2:59 p.m., Feb 6, 2026 (UTC)

  Daily Free 10-Scout Event Eligible Scout Banner Availability Period

 • Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout
 10:00 p.m., Jan 27 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 31, 2026 (UTC)

 • Spotlight Support Card Scout
 10:00 p.m., Jan 31 - 2:59 p.m., Feb 6, 2026 (UTC)

 About Free Scout Stock

 Free Scout Stock is a function that allows trainers to use the free 10x scouts accumulated each day throughout the event when logging in for the first time after it has begun.

 When Free Scout Stock is Applicable

 Applicable
 • If it is your first time logging in during the event
 Trainers can use all the free 10x scouts accumulated each day throughout the event up to that point.

 Example: If you do not log in between 10:00 p.m., Jan 27 and 2:59 p.m., Feb 2, (UTC), and log in for the first time at 3:00 p.m., Feb 2 (UTC), you can use 7 free Spotlight Support Card 10x scouts.

 Not Applicable
 • If you do not log in during the event; if you log in after the event has ended
 The Free Scout Stock cannot be used.

 • If it is not your first time logging in during the event
 The Free Scout Stock cannot be used.

 Important Information Regarding Free Scout Stock

 1. Free Scout Stock is only applicable once during the event.
 2. Free Scout Stock is applied after selecting "TAP TO START" on the title screen.
 Note: If the period during which Free Scout Stock can be used has already ended, you will be unable to use your accumulated free 10x scouts.
 3. Free Scout Stock for this event cannot be used after it has ended or in any future events. Additionally, the Free Scout Stock for any given day expires at 2:59 p.m. (UTC), even if the event has not ended.

 Important Information Regarding the Event

 1. Each free 10x scout becomes available at 3:00 p.m. (UTC). If you have not used the previous day's free scout at this time, it will be lost and cannot be carried over.
 2. The daily free 10x scout is available once per day. If the eligible scout banner changes after using your daily free 10x scout, then you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for it until the next time it resets.
 Example: If you log in at 4:00 p.m., Jan 31 (UTC), use your free 10x scout on the Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout, and the eligible scout banner changes to the Spotlight Support Card Scout at 10:00 p.m. (UTC), you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for the Spotlight Support Card Scout.
 3. If you have any free scouts remaining when this event ends, they will be lost. It is not possible to carry over free scouts to future events.
 4. There is no difference in scout rates between free scouts from this event and scouts performed on the same scout banner using carats.
 5. To check the specific rates at which Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards appear from the Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout, tap Details on the Scout screen and select the Rates tab.
 6. Scouting while your scouts are being restored may cause an error.
 7. The availability period and event contents are subject to change without notice.

 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jan 27 - 9:59 p.m., Jan 31, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 The desired conditions for each trainer's request are set according to Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only select Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions for transfer.

 A different rank exists for each request.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

At 10:00 p.m., Feb 13 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Capricorn Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Capricorn Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 Champions Meetings are unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Feb 13 - 9:59 p.m., Feb 19, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Feb 9 - 9:59 p.m., Feb 17, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Feb 13 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Feb 15 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Feb 17 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Feb 13 - 9:59 p.m., Feb 15, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Feb 15 - 9:59 p.m., Feb 17, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Feb 17 - 9:59 a.m., Feb 18, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Feb 18 - 9:59 p.m., Feb 18, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Feb 18 - 9:59 p.m., Feb 19, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Chukyo / Turf / 1,200m (Sprint) / Left-Handed / Winter / Snowy / Soft

 Changes from the Sagittarius Cup

 It is now possible to change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies during the registration period for the final round.

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B+ cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Capricorn Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Capricorn Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Capricorn Cup Platinum
 • Capricorn Cup Gold
 • Capricorn Cup Silver
 • Capricorn Cup Bronze

Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Capricorn Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in previous Champions Meetings, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately, and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. Please be aware that this event's missions reset at a different time from standard daily missions.
 9. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

As of 10:00 p.m., Feb 5 (UTC), a Racing Carnival event has begun!

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Feb 5 - 9:59 p.m., Feb 12, 2026 (UTC)

 Reward Collection / Carnival Point Exchange Period

 10:00 p.m., Feb 12 - 9:59 p.m., Feb 15, 2026 (UTC)

 Event Overview

 In Racing Carnival events, you can face off against specific Umamusume in special event races.
 Place well in these races to earn Carnival Points, which can be exchanged for a variety of useful items!

 Event Races

 There are two types of race featured in this event: standard Carnival Races, and higher-difficulty Challenge Races.
 Both types of event race cost 1 RP to enter.
 Each time you enter a Carnival Race, the Challenge Gauge will fill up by an amount based on the result you achieve.
 Once the Challenge Gauge is completely full, you will be able to trigger a Challenge Race.
 When a Challenge Race is triggered, its difficulty will be set at random to either Very Hard or Extreme, and you will face off against an opponent specific to the selected difficulty.

 Carnival Races

 Grass Wonder: Nakayama / Turf / 1,600m (Mile) / Right-Handed / Outer / Winter / Sunny / Firm
 King Halo: Nakayama / Turf / 1,800m (Mile) / Right-Handed / Inner / Winter / Sunny / Firm
 Seiun Sky: Nakayama / Turf / 2,000m (Medium) / Right-Handed / Inner / Winter / Sunny / Firm
 Special Week: Nakayama / Turf / 2,200m (Medium) / Right-Handed / Outer / Winter / Sunny / Firm

 Challenge Races

 El Condor Pasa: Tokyo / Turf / 1,600m (Mile) / Left-Handed / Winter / Sunny / Firm

 Challenge Race Opponents

 Very Hard: [El☆Número 1] El Condor Pasa
 Extreme: [Kukulkan Warrior] El Condor Pasa

 Carnival Bonus Skills

 This event features Carnival Bonus skills: special skills that are only available for the duration of the event.
 Umamusume who have learned a Carnival Bonus skill will earn bonus Carnival Points when participating in this event's races.

 Carnival Bonus Sparks

 The first step to learning a Carnival Bonus skill is to obtain a Carnival Bonus Spark by entering one of this event's races.
 Once an Umamusume has obtained one of these Sparks, use that Umamusume as a Legacy in Career mode and your trainee for that Career will be able to learn the Carnival Bonus skill.

 Levelling Up Carnival Bonus Skills

 By entering event races and completing Careers in succession, you can gain higher-level Carnival Bonus skills which provide a greater bonus to the Carnival Points you earn.
 Try to make good use of Carnival Bonus skills to efficiently earn Carnival Points and exchange them for great rewards!

 Enter event races to earn Carnival Points and get rewards!

 Carnival Points

 Carnival Points are awarded based on the results you achieve in the event's races. You can exchange them for various items in the Carnival Point Exchange.
 (For more information on Carnival Points, tap "Carnival Point Exchange" on the event's home screen or "Shop" on the bottom-left of the main Home screen.)
 
 [Notable Exchange Items]
 • Rainbow Crystal Shard
 • Gold Crystal Shard
 • Trainee Scout Ticket
 • Support Card Scout Ticket

 Event Missions

 Complete the event's Daily Missions and Special Missions to earn extra rewards.

 [Notable Mission Rewards]
 • Carats
 • Rainbow Crystal Shard
 • Gold Crystal Shard

 Important Information

 1. For more information on the event, tap the Help icon on the top right of the event's home screen.
 2. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.
 3. You cannot enter a race with a Veteran Umamusume that is the same as that race's main opponent.
 4. Carnival Points earned in this event cannot be carried over to future events.
 5. Carnival Bonus Sparks will be removed at the end of the event. They cannot be carried over to future events.
 6. Carnival Bonus skills will be removed at the end of the event. They cannot be carried over to future events.
 7. Carnival Bonus skills do not count toward your number of skills for the purpose of fulfilling conditions for epithets, missions, etc.
 8. If you start a race that ends after the conclusion of the event period, you may not be able to finish.
 9. If the event period concludes during a race, you will not receive rewards for that race.
 10. If you have unclaimed rewards for an event mission when that mission is reset, they will be sent to your Presents the next time you log in.

As of 10:00 p.m., Feb 9 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Feb 9 - 9:59 p.m., Feb 13, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Please be aware that once a Veteran Umamusume has been transferred, it cannot be recovered.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only transfer Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions.

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces the amount by one transfer.
 Once a request's remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

Your rewards will differ depending on the transfer destination.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

At 10:00 p.m., Mar 6 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Aquarius Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Aquarius Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 Champions Meetings are unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Mar 6 - 9:59 p.m., Mar 12, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Mar 2 - 9:59 p.m., Mar 10, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Mar 6 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Mar 8 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Mar 10 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Mar 6 - 9:59 p.m., Mar 8, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Mar 8 - 9:59 p.m., Mar 10, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Mar 10 - 9:59 a.m., Mar 11, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Mar 11 - 9:59 p.m., Mar 11, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Mar 11 - 9:59 p.m., Mar 12, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Tokyo / Dirt / 1,600m (Mile) / Left-Handed / Winter / Sunny / Firm

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B+ cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either an Aquarius Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either an Aquarius Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Aquarius Cup Platinum
 • Aquarius Cup Gold
 • Aquarius Cup Silver
 • Aquarius Cup Bronze

Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Aquarius Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in previous Champions Meetings, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately, and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. Please be aware that this event's missions reset at a different time from standard daily missions.
 9. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

As of 10:00 p.m., Mar 5 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Mar 5 - 9:59 p.m., Mar 9, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 The desired conditions for each trainer's request are set according to Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only select Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions for transfer.

 Rank

 A different rank exists for each request.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces your amount by one transfer.
 Once your remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

 Your rewards will differ depending on the transfer destination.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces, you will earn the Star Piece of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.

As of 10:00 p.m., Mar 12, 2026 (UTC), the Daily Free 10-Scout event has begun!

 Each day you log in during this campaign, you will be able to perform a 10x scout on one of the currently available scout banners, up to a maximum of 12 times.
 Each free 10x scout becomes available every day at 3:00 p.m. (UTC).
 The daily free 10x scout is available once per day. If the eligible scout banner changes after using your daily free 10x scout, then you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for it until the next time it resets.
 Additionally, trainers will be able to use the Free Scout Stock function only once during this event.

 Daily Free 10-Scout Event Availability Period

 • Spotlight Support Card Scout
 3:00 p.m., Mar 18 - 2:59 p.m., Mar 24, 2026 (UTC)

 About Free Scout Stock

 Free Scout Stock is a function that allows trainers to use the free 10x scouts accumulated each day throughout the event when logging in for the first time after it has begun.

 When Free Scout Stock is Applicable

 Applicable
 • If it is your first time logging in during the event
 Trainers can use all the free 10x scouts accumulated each day throughout the event up to that point.

 Example: If you do not log in between 10:00 p.m., Mar 12 and 2:59 p.m., Mar 18 (UTC), and log in for the first time at 3:00 p.m., Mar 18 (UTC), you can use 7 free Spotlight Support Card 10x scouts.

 Not Applicable
 • If you do not log in during the event; if you log in after the event has ended
 The Free Scout Stock cannot be used.

 • If it is not your first time logging in during the event
 The Free Scout Stock cannot be used.

 Important Information Regarding Free Scout Stock

 1. Free Scout Stock is only applicable once during the event.
 2. Free Scout Stock is applied after selecting "TAP TO START" on the title screen.
 Note: If the period during which Free Scout Stock can be used has already ended, you will be unable to use your accumulated free 10x scouts.
 3. Free Scout Stock for this event cannot be used after it has ended or in any future events. Additionally, the Free Scout Stock for any given day expires at 2:59 p.m. (UTC), even if the event has not ended.

 Important Information Regarding the Event

 1. Each free 10x scout becomes available at 3:00 p.m. (UTC). If you have not used the previous day's free scout at this time, it will be lost and cannot be carried over.
   2. The daily free 10x scout is available once per day. If the eligible scout banner changes after using your daily free 10x scout, then you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for it until the next time it resets.
 Example: If you log in at 4:00 p.m., Mar 23 (UTC), use your free 10x scout on the Spotlight Support Card Scout, and the eligible Scout changes to a different Spotlight Support Card Scout at 10:00 p.m. (UTC), you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for the new Spotlight Support Card Scout.
 3. If you have any free scouts remaining when this event ends, they will be lost. It is not possible to carry over free scouts to future events.
 4. There is no difference in scout rates between free scouts from this event and scouts performed on the same scout banner using carats.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Mar 12 (UTC), the new Career scenario "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax" has been added to the game!

 In this new Scenario, you can train your trainees using a different system than all previous Career Scenarios.

 To get started with the new Scenario, simply select Career from the Home screen, then select "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax"!

 "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax" Story Outline

 A new race spearheaded by the media...
 The Twinkle Star Climax.
 A competition to determine who is truly the greatest!
 At long last, racers can run as they dream
 And strive to become the best they can be!

 A departure from the usual trainee-specific goal races, this Scenario utilizes a unique set of new systems.
 Train the greatest Umamusume you can imagine!

 Scenario Systems

 Here's a sneak peek of the new systems you'll encounter in the "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax" Scenario!

 Goal

 In this new Scenario, trainees don't have their own goal races.

 The goal this time is to earn a determined amount of Result Points by the final turn in December each year.
 The playthrough will end if you have not accumulated enough points by the end of each year.
 The required number of Result Points is determined based on your trainee's year and aptitudes.

 Result Points can be earned through entering races.
 Result Points are based on the grade of the races your trainee enters and how well they place.
 Note: Result Points are reset every time you accomplish a Career goal.

 Twinkle Star Climax

 Twinkle Star Climax takes the place of the URA Finale as a new race that serves as the zenith of the Career.

 Your trainee will be entered into three races.
 Depending on how well your trainee places, you will receive Victory Points.
 Once every race is finished, the runner with the highest amount of Victory Points will be crowned champion.
 The length and distance of the race will be determined by the types of races your trainee won during her career.
 The racecourses are decided at random for each race.

 Buying items from the Pro Shop

 You can exchange Shop Coins at the Pro Shop for items to use during the playthrough.

 Items have many uses, such as raising attributes, recovering Energy, and improving the effects of training.

 Shop Coins can be earned by placing in races.
 Note: "Placing" means to finish within 5th place.
 The amount of Shop Coins you earn depends how well your trainee places.

 Rivals

 During the Scenario, Umamusume labeled "Rivals" will appear in races.
 If your trainee finishes first in a race that a Rival enters, she will see attribute gains and can acquire skill hints.

 Best Umamusume Award

 After the final turn of December each year, Umamusume are awarded for the work they put in that year.
 Your trainee will see great attribute gains for receiving an award.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on the new Career Scenario, please refer to "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax" under "Career" in Help.
 2. In the new Career Scenario, more Umamusume will be entered into races.
 3. Across all Scenarios, Matikanetannhauser's outfit will change in some races.
 4. The details of Career Scenarios are subject to change without notice.

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.

raw.message:
At 10:00 p.m., Mar 30, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Pisces Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Pisces Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Mar 30 - 9:59 p.m., Apr 5, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Mar 26 - 9:59 p.m., Apr 3, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Mar 30, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Apr 1, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Apr 3, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Mar 30 - 9:59 p.m., Apr 1, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Apr 1 - 9:59 p.m., Apr 3, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Apr 3 - 9:59 a.m., Apr 4, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Apr 4 - 9:59 p.m., Apr 4, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Apr 4 - 9:59 p.m., Apr 5, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Hanshin / Turf / 3,200m (Long) / Right-Handed / Outer → Inner / Rain / Heavy

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of B+ cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Pisces Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Pisces Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Pisces Cup Platinum
 • Pisces Cup Gold
 • Pisces Cup Silver
 • Pisces Cup Bronze

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Pisces Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Pisces Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Pisces Cup Platinum
 • Pisces Cup Gold
 • Pisces Cup Silver
 • Pisces Cup Bronze

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Pisces Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Apr 12, 2026 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Apr 12 - 9:59 p.m., Apr 16, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Veteran Umamusume that have been transferred once cannot be returned.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only transfer Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions.

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces the amount by one transfer.
 Once a request's remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

Your rewards will differ depending on the transfer destination.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

 Event Overview

 In Racing Carnival events, you can face off against specific Umamusume in special event races.
 Place well in these races to earn Carnival Points, which can be exchanged for a variety of useful items!

 Event Races

 There are two types of race featured in this event: standard Carnival Races, and higher-difficulty Challenge Races.
 Both types of event race cost 1 RP to enter.
 Each time you enter a Carnival Race, the Challenge Gauge will fill up by an amount based on the result you achieve.
 Once the Challenge Gauge is completely full, you will be able to trigger a Challenge Race.
 When a Challenge Race is triggered, its difficulty will be set at random to either Very Hard or Extreme, and you will face off against an opponent specific to the selected difficulty.

 Race Conditions

 Agnes Tachyon
 Fuji Kiseki
 Tokai Teio
