A new Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout are set to begin at 10:00 p.m., Aug 5, 2026 (UTC)!
 The Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout will feature a new Trainee Umamusume.

 During the Spotlight period, if you obtain a spotlighted 3★ Umamusume, you will receive more of her Star Pieces than usual as a bonus.

 The spotlighted Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards are listed below.
 

 Spotlight Scout Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 5 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)

 Trainee Umamusume


 ■ Debut Trainee Umamusume (Spotlight)
 ★★★ [Darl'n Snowflake] Yukino Bijin

 ■ Spotlight Trainee Umamusume
 ★★★ [Darl'n Snowflake] Yukino Bijin
 Scout Bonus:
 [Darl'n Snowflake] Yukino Bijin Star Piece × 90

 Support Cards

 ■ Support Cards (Spotlight)
 • SSR [My Umadol Way! ☆] Smart Falcon
 • SSR [Beyond This Shining Moment] Silence Suzuka

 Important Information

 1. The Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout schedules and contents are subject to change without notice.
 2. When scouting a Spotlight 2★ Trainee Umamusume, the number of Star Pieces acquired will remain the normal amount.
raw.title: New Spotlight Pretty Derby and Spotlight Support Card Scouts coming soon!

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Aug 5, 2026 (UTC), a new Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout have begun!
 The Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout features a new Trainee Umamusume.
 The Spotlight Support Card Scout features a selection of spotlighted Support Cards showcasing characters who have won the Japanese Derby.

 During the Spotlight period, scout rates for spotlighted Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards are increased!

 In addition, if you obtain a spotlighted 3★ Trainee Umamusume, you will receive more of her Star Pieces than usual as a bonus.
 During the availability period, you can earn bonuses as many times as you acquire the spotlighted 3★ Trainee Umamusume, including when you do so by using Trainee Exchange Points.
 The spotlighted Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards are listed below.

 Spotlight Scout Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 5 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)

 Trainee Umamusume

■ Debut Trainee Umamusume (Spotlight)
★★★ [Darl'n Snowflake] Yukino Bijin

 ■ Spotlight Trainee Umamusume
 ★★★ [Darl'n Snowflake] Yukino Bijin
 Scout Bonus:
 [Darl'n Snowflake] Yukino Bijin Star Piece x 90

 Support Cards

 ■ Support Cards (Spotlight)
 • SSR [My Umadol Way! ☆] Smart Falcon
 • SSR [Beyond This Shining Moment] Silence Suzuka

 Important Information

 1. To check the specific rates at which Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards appear from the Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout, tap Details on the Scout screen and select the Scout Rates tab.
 2. Support Cards will not appear in the Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout.
 3. Trainee Umamusume will not appear in the Spotlight Support Card Scout.
 4. Trainee Exchange Points and Support Card Exchange Points from this Spotlight Scout cannot be carried over to future Spotlight Scouts.
 5. Trainee Exchange Points and Support Card Exchange Points not utilized during the Spotlight Scout availability period will automatically be converted into Clovers.
 6. The Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout schedules and contents are subject to change without notice.
 7. What you can exchange Trainee Exchange Points and Support Card Exchange Points for differs depending on the Scout.
 8. Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards that you can exchange Exchange Points for may become available again in the future.
 9. Trainee Umamusume with the same name cannot be on the same team, nor can they be selected as Legacy Umamusume at the same time in Career mode.
 10. The abilities and skills of the Umamusume appearing in this Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout may differ from those of the same character in Career scenarios and Career Events.
 11. For details on the Spotlight Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards, select the Featured Trainees or Featured Cards button at the top-right of each Scout screen.
 12. When scouting a Spotlight 2★ Trainee Umamusume, the number of Star Pieces acquired will remain the normal amount.

 Umamusume Story Sneak Peek

 To celebrate the new arrival of [Darl'n Snowflake] Yukino Bijin, Episodes 1 through 4 of her Umamusume Story will be fully unlocked for a limited time!
 During the sneak peek period, you can watch the story episodes even without fulfilling their unlock conditions!

 Umamusume Story Sneak Peek Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 5 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)

 Applicable Umamusume

 • Yukino Bijin

 Important Information

 1. During the sneak peek period, even if you have not obtained the applicable Umamusume, you can still watch episodes 1 through 4 of their Umamusume Stories!
 2. If you do watch Episodes 1 through 4 of an applicable Umamusume's Umamusume Story during the sneak peek period, you will obtain first-watch carat rewards, Umamusume Story rewards, and Umamusume Archive experience.
 3. If you do not watch Episodes 1 through 4 of an applicable Umamusume's Umamusume Story during the sneak peek period, you will not obtain first-watch carat rewards, Umamusume Story rewards, or Umamusume Archive experience.
 4. After the sneak peek period has ended, any unwatched Umamusume Stories will once again become locked.
 5. Umamusume Stories can be viewed after the tutorial is completed.

raw.message:
At 10:00 p.m., Aug 8, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Virgo Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Virgo Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 8 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 14, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 5 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 12, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Aug 8, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Aug 10, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Aug 12, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Aug 8 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 10, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Aug 10 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 12, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 12 - 9:59 a.m., Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Aug 13 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 13 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 14, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Oi / Dirt / 2,000m (Medium) / Right-Handed / Fall / Sunny / Good

 The following skills will activate during this Virgo Cup.
 • Collaborative Graded Races ◎
 • Collaborative Graded Races ○
 • Collaborative Graded Races ×

 The following skills will not activate during this Virgo Cup.
 • Night Races ◎
 • Night Races ○
 • Night Races ×
 • Sharp Turns ◎
 • Sharp Turns ○
 • Sharp Turns ×

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Virgo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Virgo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Details

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Virgo Cup Platinum
 • Virgo Cup Gold
 • Virgo Cup Silver
 • Virgo Cup Bronze

 If you re-obtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Virgo Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

raw.title: The event "Trainer Aptitude Test" is coming soon!

raw.message:
Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 12 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 21, 2026 (UTC)

 Reward Collection, Test Coin Exchange, and Rankings
Display Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 21 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 24, 2026 (UTC)

 Event Overview

 The Trainer Aptitude Test is an event where trainers can test their prowess in eligible Career scenarios and aim to achieve a high score.
 Complete Careers to earn rewards based on your scores, test rating, and mission completion!

 Event-Eligible Career Scenarios

 Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert

 How to Participate

 When selecting an eligible Career scenario, you can choose "Take on a Trainer Aptitude Test" to participate.

 Test Contents

 1. Sprint Test
 2. Mile Test
 3. Medium Test
 4. Long Test
 5. Dirt Test
 6. Extra Test
 7. Free Test

 At the start of the event, you can challenge tests 1-5.
 In each attempt, you will receive a test result of "A," B," or "C."

 "Extra Test" will be unlocked once you have received a test result of at least "C" on tests 1-5.
 "Free Test" will be unlocked once you have received a test result of at least "C" on "Extra Test".

 Aim for a result of "A" to earn a unique title exclusive to this event!

 By obtaining strong test results and completing event missions, you can earn Test Coins and other rewards!

 Test Coins

 Test Coins are an item that can be obtained by taking part in this event.
 They can be exchanged for various items on the Test Coins Exchange screen.
 For more details, check the Test Coins Exchange from the event screen or under Shop on the main Home screen.

 [Main Exchangeable Items]
 • Carats
 • Rainbow Crystal Shards
 • Gold Crystal Shards
 • Trainee Scout Ticket
 • Support Card Scout Ticket
 • Rare Textbook of Hints
 • Rare Book of Hints
 • Textbook of Hints
 • Book of Hints

 This is a top score ranking of all trainers who have passed the test.
 The top 100 Leading Umamusume are updated every day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 Only the Veteran Umamusume with which you achieved the highest score during the event period is eligible to appear in this ranking.
 Note: On the first day of the event, scores are still being tallied, so no rankings are available to view.

 From 4:00 p.m., Aug 13, 2026 (UTC), Leading Umamusume ranked in the top 30 can be borrowed as legacies during the event availability period.
 There is no limit to how many times these legacies can be borrowed, but they are only available when selecting to take on the Trainer Aptitude Test in an eligible Career scenario.

 Please note that it may take some time for Leading Umamusume to become available to borrow.
 When selecting a Legacy Umamusume under the Event tab in a Career, a message reading "Tallying" may appear. If it does, please allow some time to pass before revisiting the Career screen.

 There is also a ranking for the Support Cards most frequently used in the Trainer Aptitude Test across all participating trainers.
 You can view the top 10 most-used Support Cards, updated every day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 Note: On the first day of the event, scores are still being tallied, so no rankings are available to view.

 Changes from the Previous Trainer Aptitude Test

 1. The Event Boost feature has been added.
 You can choose to add an Event Boost at the cost of twice the TP on the confirmation screen before starting a Career playthrough.
 Boosted playthroughs cost twice the TP and yield twice the amount of Test Coins as a regular run.
 (Other rewards and your test score will not change.)
 2. You can now challenge tests 1-5 from the very start of the event.
 3. On the skill acquisition screen in Career, you can now confirm skills eligible for score bonuses in the test you're currently challenging.
 4. The amount of coins you can acquire in tests has been adjusted.
 5. The number of Test Coins required to obtain some items has been adjusted in the Test Coins Exchange.
 6. The amount of monies necessary to rent Leading Umamusume has been changed to 3,000 across the board.
 7. All event screen UI has been adjusted.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on the event, tap the Help icon on the top left of the event's home screen.
   2. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.
 3. As it can take time for Leading Umamusume rankings to update, the previous day's rankings may still be displayed in some cases.
 4. If you are in the middle of a test when the event ends, you will not be able to view event results or receive event rewards for that Career playthrough.
 5. Test Coins earned in this event cannot be carried over to future events.
 6. If there are event missions listed as completed when the date changes, their rewards will be sent to your Presents. If the next day is the final day of the event, all rewards other than Test Coins will be sent to your Presents.

raw.message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Aug 12, 2026 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 12 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 16, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Please be aware that once a Veteran Umamusume has been transferred, it cannot be recovered.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only transfer Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions.

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces the amount by one transfer.
 Once a request's remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

Your rewards will differ depending on the contents and rank of the request.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The option to select all transfer requests will be changed to Off if the request list is updated due to time elapsing.
 5. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 • Monies

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Libra Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Libra Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 It is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 The ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Libra Cup Platinum
 • Libra Cup Gold
 • Libra Cup Silver
 • Libra Cup Bronze

 If you re-obtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Libra Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to Champions Meeting under Races in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

An update was released at 10:00 a.m., Nov 11 (UTC).

The details of the update are as follows:

■ Feature Updates
• Added the following new features:
◦ A new Practice mode under Race > Exhibition.
◦ A new Conversation Gallery feature in the Archive.
◦ A new Trainer Card feature under Profile.
◦ A new Change Outfit feature in the main menu.
◦ The ability to save My Runners lists in Practice and Room Match.
◦ The ability to take Photos in races, concerts, and other events.
◦ Expanded the Sort and Filter options for Veteran Umamusume, and added Memos and Favorites Icons.
• Added the following new upgrade features:
◦ New items that can be used to uncap Support Cards. (Please note that the following new items will only become available starting 10:00 p.m., Nov 11 (UTC): Rainbow Uncap Crystal, Gold Uncap Crystal, Rainbow Crystal Shard, Gold Crystal Shard)
◦ The ability to upgrade Trainee Umamusume hint levels. (Please note that the following new items will only become available starting 10:00 p.m., Nov 11 (UTC): Book of Hints, Textbook of Hints, Rare Book of Hints, Rare Textbook of Hints)
• Added the following features to Career:
◦ A new option to preview the effects of event choices.
◦ A new option to view sparks when selecting Legacies.
◦ A new Agenda feature (available after winning at least one race).
◦ Updated the display for Goal Race turns to make it clear that other races cannot be entered.
◦ Updated the Umamusume Details screen to make the effects of Conditions visible at a glance.
◦ Updated the Try Again screen to display the remaining number of retries even if no Alarm Clocks will be consumed.
• Added the following features to Team Trials:
◦ A new Quick Mode option.
• Added the following features to Room Matches:
◦ An option to create a new room with the same conditions after completing a race.
◦ An option to save race conditions for later use.
◦ An option to limit which Umamusume can enter a race.
• Added the following features to the Concert Theater:
◦ Outfit changes can now be applied in bulk to all selected Umamusume.
◦ New Singing Umamusume have been added to certain songs (existing characters only).
• Made the following adjustments to existing features:
◦ Unclaimed Event Daily Mission rewards will now be sent to your Presents the next time you log in.
◦ Shop items that are available on a monthly basis will now reset at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) on the first of each month.
◦ Added new Main Missions related to Practice.
◦ Expanded the upper limit of certain recurring Main Missions.
◦ Expanded the Friends feature to allow 5 additional follows.
◦ Updated the Scout screen to display the number of available tickets.
◦ Updated Support Cards to support the upcoming new Group type.
◦ Updated Transfer Requests to allow bulk selection of Veteran Umamusume.
◦ Updated Room Match settings to include the ranks A+, S+, and SS+.

■ Important Information
1. It may take some time for the update to appear in the store.
2. In addition, the update may fail in some cases due to the accumulation of temporary data on your device.
If you are unable to update, please turn off your device, wait a minute or two, and then restart your device and update from the store.

Thank you for supporting Umamusume: Pretty Derby!
 Here are some details regarding proper usage of the "Delete User Data" and "Delete Account" functions.

 Trainers who want to play the game over again from the start or who plan to recover their data with the Account Link function should select "Delete User Data" in order to do so, as this function is meant specifically for deleting user data saved to your device.

 For those who wish to start their game over, please select "Delete User Data" from the menu on the Title screen or Support tab from the in-game menu.

■ Important Information
 Trainers who wish to recover deleted game data in the future must first use the Account Link function before using Delete User Data.
 Once you have linked your account, you will be able to recover and play your game data.

 The "Delete Account" function differs from Delete User Data, as it does not allow for game data to be recovered or played on other devices even if you have linked your account.
 Because of this, please be careful before selecting this function, as you will be unable to recover or play any deleted data.

 We hope you'll continue to enjoy Umamusume: Pretty Derby!
raw.title: Regarding the "Delete User Data" and "Delete Account" functions

raw.message:
Thank you for supporting Umamusume: Pretty Derby!
 Here are some details regarding the Data Link and Account Link functions.

 ■ About Data Link
 Performing a Data Link allows you to play using the same Umamusume: Pretty Derby game data across multiple devices.
 To link your data to a new device, you will need your Trainer ID and a Link Password that you have set up on your existing device.

 To set up a Link Password, follow the steps below.
 1. Select Menu on the top-right of the Home screen.
 2. Select Data Link.
 3. Select Data Link once more in the window that pops up.
 4. Select the Set button next to "Set a Link Password." From here, follow the on-screen instructions to set up your Link Password.
 We recommend that you keep a note of your Trainer ID and Link Password and take care not to lose it.

 ■ About Account Link
 Performing an Account Link allows you to recover your Umamusume: Pretty Derby game data if your current device is damaged, lost, or replaced.
 Please be aware that Facebook accounts cannot be used to link your data with a device that uses a different platform. They can only be used to recover data.

 For further information about the Data Link and Account Link features, please refer to the in-game Help.
(Menu > Help & Glossary > Help > Menu > Data Link / Account Link)

 We hope you'll continue to enjoy Umamusume: Pretty Derby!
raw.title: Regarding the Data Link and Account Link functions

 ■ Date and Time

 Note: Please be aware that changes caused by the update may not appear in Career playthroughs started around the time of the update.

 ■ Adjustment Details
 • Increased monies and Support Points earned in Career.
 • Increased monies and Support Points earned at the end of a Career.
 • Increased parameters gained from Career end events.
 • Increased the number of recreation events for R Friend type Support Cards.
 • Increased the rate at which Friend type Support Cards events occur when they are in your deck.
 • Adjusted choice options for Career end events when Friend type Support Cards are in your deck.
 • Adjusted the probability of training failure when max energy is increased.
 • Friend type Support Card events may now occur at a low rate even if they are not in your deck.
 • Adjusted Careers to mitigate the effects of bad conditions:
     ◦ Increased the probability to recover more energy when Resting while afflicted with "Night Owl."
     ◦ Decreased the probability of being afflicted with a bad condition from some trainee events.
     ◦ Removed mood decreases when being afflicted with a bad condition from some events.
     ◦ Mood decreases when unable to train as a result of the "Slacker" condition now occur randomly.
     ◦ Rest and Recreation during Summer Camp now cures bad conditions.
     ◦ Resting now has a chance to cure the "Night Owl" and "Skin Outbreak" conditions.
     ◦ Training with Etsuko Otonashi now has a chance to cure the "Slacker" condition.
     ◦ Certain Career events now cure bad conditions.
 • Adjusted race systems:
     ◦ Added the "Spot Struggle" system.
     ◦ Added the "Dueling" system.
     ◦ Added the "Runaway" aptitude skill.
     ◦ Increased runners' last spurt speed based on their Guts parameter.
     ◦ Adjusted systems involving hills on courses.
     ◦ Adjusted racer positioning at the final corner, allowing them to line up more easily.
     ◦ Skills that improve navigation now also improve passing ability during their duration.
     ◦ Recovering endurance late-race now enables runners to exert full strength based on the endurance recovered.

raw.message:
As of 8:00 a.m., Dec 17 (UTC), it is now possible to perform an Account Link with Cygames ID!
 (If you do not already have a Cygames ID, you will need to create a free Cygames ID to use this feature.)

 By linking a Cygames ID to your game data, you can take advantage of the following features and services:
 • You can use your Cygames ID to carry over your data to a new device.
 • You can purchase in-game items from the Cygames WebStore and take advantage of bargains that may not be available in game. (Paid carats purchased from the Cygames WebStore are not tied to a specific platform and will be available on all devices linked to your game data.)
 Please note that Cygames WebStore purchases will be processed in US dollars.

 About Cygames ID

 Cygames ID is an account system designed for use with various Cygames services. For more information, please refer to the website linked below.

 ■ Cygames ID Website
 (This link will open an external site.)
 https://cygames.com/en/

 ■ About Cygames WebStore
 The Cygames WebStore is an online store where you can purchase in-game items and take advantage of exclusive deals.
 For more information, please refer to the store web page below.

 • Cygames WebStore
 (This link will open an external site.)
 https://webstore.cygames.com/umamusume/

 How to Link with Cygames ID

 1. In the Umamusume: Pretty Derby app, open the menu from the Home screen, then tap "Account Link."
 2. Tap the Account Link button to confirm.
 3. Tap "Sign In to Cygames ID."
 4. Tap the Account Link button to confirm.
 5. Select a sign-in method in the external browser. (If you select a third-party account or email address that is not currently associated with a Cygames ID, a new Cygames ID will be created.)
 6. After signing in to your Cygames ID in the external browser, the Trainer ID and trainer name of the account to be linked will be displayed.
 7. Tap the OK button to confirm and complete the Account Link process.
 (It is also possible to perform an Account Link from the menu on the title screen.)

How to Sign In to Your Cygames ID from the Menu


 Important Information

 • Each Cygames ID can only be linked to a single Trainer ID.
 • When signing in to your Cygames ID, if you select a third-party account or email address that is not currently associated with a Cygames ID, a new Cygames ID will be created. If you would like to use multiple third-party accounts with the same Cygames ID, please link those accounts to your Cygames ID first from the Cygames ID website.
 Please note that once you have linked a Cygames ID, linking a different Cygames ID will cause data to be overwritten.

 ■ Example of Data Overwriting
 1. A player links their game data to Cygames ID A which was created using Third-Party Account A.
 2. The player then signs into Cygames ID using Third-Party Account B, which has not previously been used with Cygames ID. This causes Cygames ID B to be created.
 3. The player then continues to link their game data to Cygames ID B, causing the existing link with Cygames ID A to be overwritten.

 After completing Step 3, it will only be possible to use this game data and associated services using Cygames ID B.
 If, before performing Step 2, the player first signs in to the Cygames ID website using Cygames ID A and registers Third-Party Account B to this ID, no new Cygames ID will be created and it will be possible to continue using Cygames ID A with this account.
 When linking an account, please be careful to check that it is associated with the correct Cygames ID.

 • Please note that if you link your game data to a new device on a different platform, paid carats purchased on the previous platform will not be available for use on the new platform. (Paid carats purchased from the Cygames WebStore will remain available on all linked devices regardless of platform.)
 • After purchasing in-game items from the Cygames WebStore, they will become available in game when one of the following actions is performed:
 1. Opening the Scout screen
 2. Attempting to perform a scout
 3. Opening the Home screen from the title screen
 In each of these cases, a dialog box will appear to confirm that your purchase has been reflected.
 • Cygames WebStore purchases are available only after you have completed the in-game tutorial and confirmed your year and month of birth. (If you have not confirmed your year and month of birth, you can do so by pressing the "+" button next to your carat total on the Home screen, or by selecting the Purchase Carats option from the menu.)

An update was released at 11:00 a.m., Jul 1, 2026 (UTC).

 The details of the update are as follows:

 ■ Feature Updates

 New Features

 • An option to reroll Sparks at the end of a Career.
 • A new Photo Studio mode.
 • The ability to create a Club Card.
 • An option to transfer data using an iCloud backup.

 Updates to the URA Finale Scenario

 Training with Happy Meek


 Happy Meek will now appear as a training partner in this scenario.

 Dueling with Happy Meek


 When Happy Meek appears in training with a special icon, you can face off against her in a duel event after that training session.
 In this event, you can choose one of three contests (one based on the selected training type, and two chosen at random) and pit your trainee against Happy Meek based on a specific attribute or current Energy level.
 Each available contest is displayed with a prediction of the outcome.
 If you win the duel, your trainee will gain attributes, earn skill points, and obtain skill hints based on the chosen contest.
 As you win duels, future duels will increase in level and difficulty, but also offer greater attribute gains and skill point rewards.
 Try to compete with Happy Meek as much as possible to maximize the benefits!
 (Note: There is a limit to how far the level and difficulty of duels with Happy Meek can increase.)

 URA Finale Finals


 If your trainee defeats Happy Meek in enough duels over the course of a Career, Happy Meek will appear in the URA Finale Finals with increased abilities.
 Defeat this stronger Happy Meek to gain more attributes and skill points than normal, along with a new Rare Skill.
 This also increases your chances of obtaining the URA Finale Scenario Spark, and if you have learned any skills from your duels with Happy Meek, the Sparks for these skills will be upgraded into special versions that grant attributes or skill points in addition to skill hints.
 Try to train up a powerful racer who will be able to defeat Happy Meek at her strongest!

 Training


 The attribute values and skill points gained from training in this scenario have been adjusted.

 New Summer Camp Event


 The director will now visit your trainee with refreshments during summer camp in a new Energy-restoring event.

 Endings


 The attribute values and skill points obtained from certain endings have been adjusted.

 Updates to the Unity Cup Scenario

 Extreme Spirit Bursts


 Team members who have already triggered a Spirit Burst can now trigger an additional Extreme Spirit Burst once per Career.
 This special Spirit Burst provides a boost to that team member's attributes and attribute caps.
 What's more, in addition to gaining more from the training session than usual, your trainee can also earn a special skill hint.
 When an Extreme Spirit Burst is available, the failure rate for that training is reduced to 0%, so try to take advantage of them when they appear!

 Elite Teams


 If you fulfill certain conditions during a Career, you'll be able to face off against a special Elite Team.
 Defeating an Elite Team gives your trainee a big boost, so try to make sure your team is up to the task!
 The conditions to face an Elite Team are as follows:
 1. Your team is in the top 10 in the Unity Cup rankings
 2. Your Team Power is A or higher
 3. You have triggered at least one Extreme Spirit Burst

 Upgraded Team Zenith


 If you successfully defeat the Elite Team, Team Zenith will appear in the Unity Cup Finals with increased abilities.
 They won't be easy to defeat, so make sure to train up your whole team as much as possible!
 Defeating this more powerful Team Zenith will contribute greatly to your trainee's growth.
 This also increases your chances of obtaining the Unity Cup Scenario Spark, and if you have learned any Ignited Spirit or Burning Spirit skills, the Sparks for these skills will also be upgraded into special versions that grant attributes or skill points in addition to skill hints.

 New Team Power Rank: S+


 There is now an additional Team Power rank of S+ to achieve after the previous maximum of S.
 Achieving a Team Power of S+ will grant significant gains to your trainee.

 Retrying Unity Cup Races


 If you lose one of the team races that make up the Unity Cup, you will now have the option to consume an item to retry.
 When this option is selected, you can return to before the race and choose a different opposing team if you wish. When retrying, brackets will be reassigned, and the Mood of your aces will be increased by one level for the duration of the race.
 (Reassigned brackets are not guaranteed to be different from previous attempts.)

 Adjustments to Unity Training and Spirit Bursts


 The attribute values and skill points gained from Unity Training and Spirit Bursts have been adjusted.
 Unity Training and Spirit Bursts no longer require training to consume more Energy.
 Skill hints obtained from Spirit Bursts will now be selected from the skills of the team members who triggered them.

 Career Events


 The attribute values and skill points gained from certain Career Events have been adjusted.

 Training


 The attribute values and skill points gained from training in this scenario have been adjusted.

 Updates to Career

 • It is now possible to increase your trainee's attribute caps during a Career.
 (Attribute cap increase is dependent on the selected Career scenario and the outcome of Inspiration events. In addition, all attribute gains in excess of 1,200 will be halved.)
 • The Skip feature has been updated to progress more quickly during Career Events when set to the maximum speed.
 • Adjustments have been made to the text displayed in Career Events when obtaining a hint for a skill that has already been learned.

 Updates to Scouts

 • Added an option to use multiple scout tickets at once on the Scout screen.
 • Adjusted the UI for Make Debut Scouts.
 • Adjusted the conditions for certain animations in Pretty Derby Scouts.

 Updates to Daily Sales

 • Items will now be added to the Daily Sale shop cumulatively each time the conditions to trigger the shop are met. As this makes it unnecessary to close the shop, the button to do so has been removed.
 • Once triggered, the Daily Sale shop will now be available until the next daily reset at 3:00 p.m. (UTC), without the time limit that was previously applied.
 • It is now possible to buy multiple Daily Sale items at once by selecting them using checkboxes. There is also a Select All button to easily buy the entire stock.
[The Daily Sale function update will be applied from 3:00 p.m., July 3, 2026 (UTC).]

 Updates to Existing Features

 • Expanded the Friends feature to allow 10 additional follows.
 • Expanded the Veteran Umamusume list to allow 20 additional saved racers.
 • When viewing Umamusume details, it is now possible to flick or drag to scroll between Umamusume in the current list.
 • Expanded Filter options for Veteran Umamusume to allow filtering by common Sparks.
 ("Common Sparks" refers collectively to Scenario Sparks, race Sparks, and skill Sparks.)
 • Expanded Filter options for Veteran Umamusume to allow filtering by specific Unique Sparks.
 • Expanded Filter options for Support Cards to allow filtering by specific Support Effects.
 • Updated the Race Results screen with a new option to take photos.
 • Updated the Team Trials screen with a new Race History feature.
 (Race history can only be viewed for races that take place after this update.)
 • Updated the Concert Theater with a new feature to save and load concert lineups.
 (To use this feature, select the Presets button on the Concert Theater screen.)
 • Updated the Concert Theater with a new feature to apply costume changes to all performers at once.
 • Updated the Paid Carats Details screen to display a more detailed breakdown of purchased products and carat totals.
 • Expanded the Item Request feature in Clubs to allow the requesting of Winner's Sashes.
 • Updated the Race Events screen to display only events that are currently ongoing, upcoming, or in their reward collection period. Events that are not currently available will not appear.
 • Adjusted the unlock conditions for skill activation voices in Trainer Notes as follows:
 Before: Activate the relevant skill.
 After: Hear the voice line for the skill or raise the Trainee Umamusume to at least 3★.

 New Item

 • Added the new Gallery Key item.
(Gallery Keys will become available to obtain from 10:00 p.m., Jul 2, 2026 (UTC). Some are planned to be distributed as a gift, and they will also be added to the Friend Point Exchange lineup.)

 ■ Important Information
 1. It may take some time for the update to appear in the store.
 2. In addition, the update may fail in some cases due to the accumulation of temporary data on your device.
 If you are unable to update, please turn off your device, wait a minute or two, and then restart your device and update from the store.

raw.title: Update Announcement

raw.message:
Balance adjustments will be made at the below date and time.

 ■ Date and Time
 11:00 a.m., Jul 1, 2026 (UTC)
 Note: Changes caused by the update may not appear in Career playthroughs started around the time of the update.

 ■ Adjustment Details
 Adjustments will be made to the following mechanics of Umamusume's positioning during races in accordance with their selected running style.
 • Umamusume using the Front Runner strategy will behave differently depending on whether there are other Front Runners in the race.
 • Velocity decreases during position adjustment will be adjusted.
 • The frequency and mechanics of position adjustment during race progression will be adjusted.

 Adjustments will be made to activation conditions for the following skills.
 • Tantalizing Trick
 • Trick (Front)
 • Trick (Rear)
 • Frenzied Front Runners
 • Frenzied Pace Chasers
 • Frenzied Late Surgers
 • Frenzied End Closers

 In addition, the following will also be adjusted:  • The degree to which the excess portion of an attribute exceeding 1,200 affects an Umamusume during a race.
 • Certain parameters that can be acquired in Career Events.
 • Mechanics of Career Events that occur after an Outing.
 • Mechanics of affinity bonuses and Veteran Umamusume affinity bonuses.
 • Certain effects of the Pure Passion condition.
 • Certain skill conditions and their effects.
 • Certain race mechanics.
 • Certain skill detail text.
(Only the text will be adjusted. Skill effects will not be changed.)

 [Adjusted Skills]
 KEEP IT REAL. (Unique Skill)
 KEEP IT REAL. (Legacy Skill)

 ■ Important Information
 1. Changes caused by the update may not appear in Career playthroughs started around the time of the update.
 2. The progression of previously saved races will not be affected by the balance adjustments. However, some effects and voices may no longer line up with things that happened.
 3. The contents of these balance adjustments may be changed without warning.

During the period listed below, we will be conducting maintenance related to the addition of new racecourses and dirt races.

 ■ Deletion of In-Progress Career Data
 As the new additions affect the contents of Career mode, any in-progress Career playthrough that has not been finished prior to maintenance will be deleted.
 No compensation will be provided to players whose in-progress Career data was deleted due to this maintenance.

 ■ Maintenance Period
 7:00 a.m. - 8:00 a.m., Jul 14, 2026 (UTC)

 ■ Important Information
 1. During the maintenance period, it will not be possible to play the game or use any related features such as performing a data link.
 2. Immediately after maintenance ends, connectivity issues may occur due to increased user activity. If you experience any such issues, please try logging in again later.
 3. Start and end times for the maintenance period are subject to change without notice.

 [Update: 8:30 a.m., Jul 14, 2026 (UTC)]
 As of 8:00 a.m. (UTC), the maintenance period has concluded.
 As appreciation for your cooperation, we have gifted eligible trainers with 50 carats.

 ■Collection Period
 8:30 a.m., Jul 14 - 11:59 p.m., Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)

 ■ Eligible Trainers
 Trainers who started the game before maintenance began.

 We sincerely apologize to all trainers who faced inconveniences due to this maintenance.
 We hope you'll continue to enjoy Umamusume: Pretty Derby!

raw.message:
As of 8:00 a.m., Jul 22, 2026 (UTC), the Independent Training function has been added to the game and can be used in all Career Scenarios!


■ About Independent Training
 Independent Training is a function that automatically advances a Career, completing it about 50 minutes after it starts.
 The Independent Training timer will progress even if you close the application.
 Additionally, content such as Umamusume Stories and races is playable by returning to the Home screen.
 (Unlike normal Career playthroughs, Independent Training has its own unique way of handling training and events that occur during the Career.)

 ■ Starting Independent Training
 Starting Independent Training remains the same as a normal Career up through editing your Support Card deck. During the Final Confirmation screen, Independent Training can be started by selecting the Independent Training tab and starting the playthrough.

 ■ Completing Independent Training
 When the remaining time reaches 0:00:00, you will be taken to the Complete Career screen, and your Independent Training log will display.
 The Independent Training log can be used to confirm info such as your Career results, score, obtained skill hints, and Inspiration records.
 After the Independent Training log is displayed, the rest of the Career completion process is the same as a normal Career.
 Points from all types of events, fans earned, Bond Level, and race rewards are obtained the same as in a normal Career.
 For more information, please check Independent Training from the Career tab under Menu in Help.

 ■ Important Information
 1. You cannot switch to a normal Career during Independent Training.
 2. Only epithets specific to Independent Training can be obtained.
 3. Goal achievement status per scenario will be treated using rules specific to Independent Training. Independent Training will continue even if goals haven't been completed.
 Additionally, you can still enter other race classes even if your trainee does not win her maiden race.
 4. In Independent Training, you cannot acquire trophies from winning races.
 5. In Independent Training, Career events and concerts cannot be viewed.
Because of this, nothing will unlock in the Concert Theater or Gallery.
 6. In Independent Training, missions tied to Career Scenarios, missions with requirements based on statistics that aren't displayed in the Independent Training log, as well as some other missions, will not progress.
 7. Career results will not be finalized until the Independent Training log is displayed. Results that depend on the completion of a Career playthrough, such as events and rewards with a daily limit, will be reflected once the Independent Training log displays for the first time.

raw.message:
Dear Trainers,
 Today we'd like to share with you a little bit about our plans for the English version of Umamusume: Pretty Derby.
 

Pacing

 First, you can expect to see all the same events and Scouts as in the Japanese version. However, we want you to experience the latest content sooner rather than later, so content will be released at a faster pace, with shorter gaps in between events and Scouts, but the durations of the events and Scouts themselves will be the same as they originally were in the Japanese version.
 

Expedited Features

 Second, the English version will have the following features available on release:
 • Landscape mode in races
 • Jukebox
 We also plan to selectively implement other new features and quality of life changes earlier than in the Japanese version going forward.
 For example, we are already working on the Guided Career feature, which the Japanese version didn't receive until its 4th anniversary. We'll keep you updated on when you can expect to see it in game.
 

Cross-Platform

 Lastly, the English version will feature cross-platform play between mobile and PC. You can use the same account to play on either platform.

 With your input and support, we hope to deliver a player-friendly experience to trainers around the globe. Thank you for your patience, and we'll see you at Tracen Academy.

 The Umamusume: Pretty Derby Team

raw.message:
Cygames has revealed the details for 7th Event: THE STAGE in LOS ANGELES, the North American leg of Umamusume: Pretty Derby's world tour. The two-day concert is to be held in LA's Peacock Theater starting at 8:00 p.m., Oct 22 and 7:00 p.m., Oct 23, 2026 (PT). The key art and lineup are now live on the official website, and ticket sales will begin at 10:00 a.m., Jul 23, 2026 (PT).

7th EVENT: THE STAGE in LOS ANGELES Lineup

 * List is subject to change.

7th EVENT: THE STAGE in LOS ANGELES Ticketing Overview

Ticket sales will begin at 10:00 a.m., Jul 23, 2026 (PT) online via AXS and will be sold on a first-come, first-served basis. Prices vary by seating zone. Online streaming is also planned for the event.

Ticketing Details:

www.axs.com/events/1484017?skin=peacock

Prices by Seating Zone:

 -    VIP: $350 (1F frontal area, merch pack included)
 -    P1: $150
 -    P2: $100
 -    P3: $80

VIP Perks:

VIP tickets come bundled with a merch pack, which includes the following items packaged in an event-edition box and carrying bag:
 -    Figurine-Style Pin Set (7th EVENT in LOS ANGELES Edition)
 -    THE STAGE Band Shirt (7th EVENT in LOS ANGELES Edition)
 -    Commemorative Ticket (7th EVENT in LOS ANGELES Edition)
* Images are for illustrative purposes only. Actual item designs may differ from the images shown.

-    The products included are the same for both days of the concert.
-    The band shirt comes in one size, roughly equivalent to an American XL. Measurements in inches:
       -    Length: 30.3–32.3
       -    Width: 23.2–24.0
       -    Shoulder: 21.7–22.0
       -    Sleeve: 8.3–10.2
-    The merch pack can only be picked up at the concert venue on the date of its bundled ticket. The pack will not be shipped, so please be sure to collect it in-person on the correct day.
-    The products in the merch pack cannot be returned or exchanged except in the case of defects.

Figurine-Style Pin Set Details:

A set of pins packaged in boxes reminiscent of collectible figurines. Display them in their original decorative boxes or take them out to use as pins.

THE STAGE Band Shirt Details:

A T-shirt with metallic details. The back features a list of all the Umamusume who will perform at the concert.

Commemorative Ticket Details:

An extra decorative replica of your ticket to keep as memorabilia. Made of paper.


Ticketing Schedule:

AMEX Presale:

10:00 a.m., Jul 23–10:00 p.m., Jul 24, 2026 (PT)
Use of an eligible American Express (AMEX) card at checkout is required to purchase AMEX presale tickets.

Goldenvoice Presale:

10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m., Jul 27, 2026 (PT)
Sign up for the Goldenvoice newsletter to receive a presale code.

Venue Presale:

10:00 a.m. – 10:00 p.m., Jul 27, 2026 (PT)
Sign up for the Peacock Theater newsletter to receive a presale code.

General Sale:

Starts 10:00 a.m., Jul 28, 2026 (PT)
Tickets available while stock lasts. An AXS account is required.
